# Let's Get Your AI Right

Global enterprises trust Alation to get their AI right — and keep it right.

It's why we built the Alation Intelligence Operating System.

[Start a Conversation][19][SEE HOW IT WORKS][20]

TRUSTED BY DATA LEADERS WHO CAN’T AFFORD TO GET IT WRONG
* [BBC Logo]
* [Brambles Logo]
* [Cisco logo]
* [CNA Logo]
* [Children's Hospital of Philadelphia Logo]
* [Euromonitor International logo]
* [Finnair logo]
* [Georgia Pacific logo]
* [8451 logo]
* [Lipton Teas and Infusions logo]
* [M&S logo]
* [Nasdaq logo]
* [NTT docomo logo]
* [Sallie Mae logo]

I

THE PROBLEM

## AI can quietly (and confidently) break. The problem is figuring out where and why.

An agent gives you the wrong answer. Is it the data, the context, the agent, two of the three, or
all of it at the same time?
* 01 _Bad data reaches the agentStale, wrong, or drifting data... and the agent acts on it
  confidently. Detect and remediate before it ships.
* 02 _The agent misreads contextConflicting definitions, missing semantics. Context is built and
  tested against real data and real agents, not guessed.
* 03 _The agent itself is wrongYour prompt is old or wrong. You have too few tools or too many, or
  they're old.

II

THE ANSWER IS AIOS

## The Alation Intelligence Operating System ensures your data apps and agents are accurate.

Because there are so many ways to get the wrong answer, you see whether it was the data, the
context, or the agent — and fix the right thing, with the right feedback, to constantly improve.

[Diagram of what is inside AIOS: Governance of self-improving feedback loops covering agents,
context, and data.]
III

Solutions

## For the work you can’t afford to get wrong.

AIOS powers solutions to your most critical business challenges.
* ### Agentic Compliance
  
  Prove it on demand, not when the auditor calls.
* ### Conversational Analytics
  
  Ask in plain language. Get answers you can defend.
* ### Agentic Data Governance
  
  Control, context, and lineage — so every decision holds up.
* ### Agentic Automation
  
  With Agent Studio, automate processes with data you can trust.
* ### AI Governance
  
  Govern AI by use case, with proof already assembled.

[Aerial view of a logistics facility with a red semi-truck and white trailer parked near a warehouse
loading dock.]

## The data trust layer for your modern AI stack

Data Trust Index scores your data. MCP connects it to your AI stack.

Click any layer to explore

[Applications]
Applications
Layer 5

### Applications

Value realization

This is the layer enterprises actually feel. Agents don't surface outputs for human review here,
they **execute inside operational systems**. Refunds are issued. Compliance escalations are filed.
Service requests are routed and resolved, all at machine speed.

What lives here:
* Autonomous AI agents built on platforms like Agentforce, ServiceNow, and Ironclad
* Copilots powered by ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Power BI
* Chatbots and self-service applications like Fin AI and Sierra
* Custom-built AI apps using Cursor, Replit, and Bolt

#### The foundation decides the outcome

The quality of everything below this layer determines whether this layer is an asset or a liability.
Agents can only be trusted to act autonomously when the data they act on has been validated,
certified, and cleared, before execution, not after.

Layer 4
[Agent orchestration]
Agent orchestration
Layer 4

### Agent orchestration

Reasoning & planning

This is where large language models, agent frameworks, and retrieval systems **take trusted data and
turn it into action.** Agents reason over enterprise context, plan sequences of steps, and
coordinate execution across systems, without a human authorizing each move.

What lives here:
* Agent frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, and LlamaIndex
* Foundational models including GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama, and others
* Vector stores for retrieval-augmented generation
* MCP as the interface connecting agents to governed data sources and tools

#### Probabilistic reasoning needs a deterministic foundation

LLMs are powerful precisely because they handle ambiguity well. But when agents trigger financial
transactions or compliance actions, that same flexibility becomes a risk. Orchestration can't
resolve data conflicts on its own, it needs certified, governed context passed up from the layer
below.

Layer 5
Layer 3
[Data trust layer]
Data trust layer
[gradient]
Layer 3

### Data trust layer

Context & quality
[ataccama one]
[ataccama one]

Most AI initiatives have Layers 1, 2, 4, and 5. What they're missing is this one. **The Data trust
layer sits between consolidated data and the systems that act on it**, validating, governing,
resolving, and certifying data before any agent is permitted to execute against it.

What lives here:
* Data quality validation and automated remediation at the source
* Entity resolution that produces a single authoritative master record
* Data governance including catalog, lineage, and business definitions
* Continuous observability that detects anomalies as they emerge
* The Data Trust Index: a real-time, machine-readable signal that tells agents whether a dataset is
  cleared for autonomous action

#### Available data isn't trusted data

The gap between available and trusted is exactly where agentic AI breaks down. Data that loads
without errors and passes schema checks can still carry duplicates, stale values, and missing
context. This layer closes that gap, continuously, across the entire data estate. Ataccama ONE
delivers this layer as a unified platform, combining data quality, observability, governance,
lineage and reference & master into a single environment purpose-built for trusted agentic AI.

Layer 4
Layer 2
[Cloud lake houses]
Cloud lake houses
Layer 2

### Cloud lake houses

Storage & compute

Before AI can operate at scale, enterprise data needs to live in one place. Cloud lakehouses
**consolidate fragmented source data into a scalable, compute-capable environment** built for modern
AI workloads, eliminating the infrastructure barriers that make coordinated AI deployment nearly
impossible.

What lives here:
* Cloud data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, and Google BigQuery
* Native Python execution for data science and ML pipelines
* Open table formats like Apache Iceberg for cross-platform flexibility

#### Consolidation solves infrastructure. It doesn't solve quality

Centralizing data is the necessary first move, and the return is substantial. But migrating data to
a modern cloud platform doesn't clean it, resolve duplicate entities, or certify it for AI use. That
work happens in the layer above.

Layer 3
Layer 1
[Data sources]
Data sources
Layer 1

### Data sources

Raw data

Every enterprise AI program starts here, with the operational systems that run the business. ERP
platforms, CRMs, billing systems, document repositories, and data feeds that were built for process
efficiency, not AI consumption. **The data is there. The problem is what it carries.**

What lives here:
* Structured sources like SAP, Workday, Oracle, Salesforce, NetSuite, PostgreSQL
* Unstructured sources like Slack, Gmail, SharePoint, Notion, Google Drive
* Operational and transactional feeds across business functions

#### Years of quality debt come with the territory

Source systems accumulate inconsistent entity definitions, duplicate records, incomplete fields, and
business logic that varies by region, system vintage, or the migration that last touched them.

Layer 5

### Applications

Value realization

This is the layer enterprises actually feel. Agents don't surface outputs for human review here,
they **execute inside operational systems**. Refunds are issued. Compliance escalations are filed.
Service requests are routed and resolved, all at machine speed.

What lives here:
* Autonomous AI agents built on platforms like Agentforce, ServiceNow, and Ironclad
* Copilots powered by ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Power BI
* Chatbots and self-service applications like Fin AI and Sierra
* Custom-built AI apps using Cursor, Replit, and Bolt

#### The foundation decides the outcome

The quality of everything below this layer determines whether this layer is an asset or a liability.
Agents can only be trusted to act autonomously when the data they act on has been validated,
certified, and cleared, before execution, not after.

Layer 4
[Agent orchestration]
Agent orchestration
Layer 4

### Agent orchestration

Reasoning & planning

This is where large language models, agent frameworks, and retrieval systems **take trusted data and
turn it into action.** Agents reason over enterprise context, plan sequences of steps, and
coordinate execution across systems, without a human authorizing each move.

What lives here:
* Agent frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, and LlamaIndex
* Foundational models including GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama, and others
* Vector stores for retrieval-augmented generation
* MCP as the interface connecting agents to governed data sources and tools

#### Probabilistic reasoning needs a deterministic foundation

LLMs are powerful precisely because they handle ambiguity well. But when agents trigger financial
transactions or compliance actions, that same flexibility becomes a risk. Orchestration can't
resolve data conflicts on its own, it needs certified, governed context passed up from the layer
below.

### Data trust layer

Most AI initiatives have Layers 1, 2, 4, and 5. What they're missing is this one. **The Data trust
layer sits between consolidated data and the systems that act on it**, validating, governing,
resolving, and certifying data before any agent is permitted to execute against it.

What lives here:
* Data quality validation and automated remediation at the source
* Entity resolution that produces a single authoritative master record
* Data governance including catalog, lineage, and business definitions
* Continuous observability that detects anomalies as they emerge
* The Data Trust Index: a real-time, machine-readable signal that tells agents whether a dataset is
  cleared for autonomous action

#### Available data isn't trusted data

The gap between available and trusted is exactly where agentic AI breaks down. Data that loads
without errors and passes schema checks can still carry duplicates, stale values, and missing
context. This layer closes that gap, continuously, across the entire data estate. Ataccama ONE
delivers this layer as a unified platform, combining data quality, observability, governance,
lineage and reference & master into a single environment purpose-built for trusted agentic AI.

**consolidate fragmented source data into a scalable, compute-capable environment** built for modern
AI workloads, eliminating the infrastructure barriers that make coordinated AI deployment nearly
impossible.

What lives here:

* Native Python execution for data science and ML pipelines

Centralizing data is the necessary first move, and the return is substantial. But migrating data to

work happens in the layer above.

### Get to know Collibra

*What is Collibra?*
  Collibra is the Enterprise AI Control Plane — the layer of context and control that sits above
  every data platform, model, and agent. Built on eighteen years of ontology engineering, it turns
  scattered data into governed context: the certified knowledge about an organization. It lets teams
  certify and govern context, serve it to the AI models and agents that consume it, and govern what
  those systems do, across any data, any model, any agent, without moving your data or locking into
  a single platform.
*What is an ontology?*
  Ontology is the digital twin of the knowledge an organization has. It is a formal knowledge graph
  of an organization’s business concepts, terms, and relationships (including lineage, business
  rules and definitions, semantics and other organizations specific information) that gives AI
  agents and data consumers the governed context they need to act on data with confidence. Unlike a
  glossary, an ontology captures how concepts connect, linking customers to contracts, products to
  policies, and data to decisions. In Collibra, ontologies power intelligent discovery, lineage, and
  AI-ready governance across the enterprise.
*What is context governance?*
  Context governance is the practice of making enterprise context (meaning, trust and
  permissions/policies) trustworthy enough that an AI agent can rely on it for every decision.
  Context governance is operationalized through governed, curated, certified, semantically enriched
  data products that carry their context with them. Agents and humans don't search through
  ungoverned lakes. They pull from a marketplace where every product carries its meaning, lineage,
  quality signals, and policy constraints so the agent's three questions are answered before it ever
  touches the data.
*What is AI governance?*
  AI governance is the set of frameworks, processes, and controls that ensure the AI agents and
  systems within enterprise deploys are grounded in trusted context, operate within defined
  boundaries, and can be traced and audited. It's how organizations manage the risks that surface
  when AI meets the business: unclear ownership, poor traceability, unreliable data, model bias, and
  regulatory exposure.
*What is context engineering?*
  Context engineering is the practice of structuring and delivering the right data, instructions and
  knowledge to AI systems so they can understand intent and produce accurate, relevant outputs.
  Context engineering goes beyond prompt engineering to shape everything the AI needs to act
  effectively, using both structured and unstructured data sources.
*What is Deasy Labs?*
  Deasy Labs turns just about any unstructured data, your company's enormous SharePoint, decades of
  emails, a million PDFs, into the perfect dataset for whatever your team is actually building with
  AI. For the first time, your governance policies reach all of your data. Automatic tagging and
  metadata enrichment surface what you have and what's relevant to your AI project. Filtering and
  sensitive data detection make sure the wrong content never gets in, eliminating wasted tokens. The
  result: less time wrangling data, more time shipping AI that delivers on accuracy.

### Get to know Collibra

*What is Collibra?*
  Collibra is the Enterprise AI Control Plane — the layer of context and control that sits above
  every data platform, model, and agent. Built on eighteen years of ontology engineering, it turns
  scattered data into governed context: the certified knowledge about an organization. It lets teams
  certify and govern context, serve it to the AI models and agents that consume it, and govern what
  those systems do, across any data, any model, any agent, without moving your data or locking into
  a single platform.
*What is an ontology?*
  Ontology is the digital twin of the knowledge an organization has. It is a formal knowledge graph
  of an organization’s business concepts, terms, and relationships (including lineage, business
  rules and definitions, semantics and other organizations specific information) that gives AI
  agents and data consumers the governed context they need to act on data with confidence. Unlike a
  glossary, an ontology captures how concepts connect, linking customers to contracts, products to
  policies, and data to decisions. In Collibra, ontologies power intelligent discovery, lineage, and
  AI-ready governance across the enterprise.
*What is context governance?*
  Context governance is the practice of making enterprise context (meaning, trust and
  permissions/policies) trustworthy enough that an AI agent can rely on it for every decision.
  Context governance is operationalized through governed, curated, certified, semantically enriched
  data products that carry their context with them. Agents and humans don't search through
  ungoverned lakes. They pull from a marketplace where every product carries its meaning, lineage,
  quality signals, and policy constraints so the agent's three questions are answered before it ever
  touches the data.
*What is AI governance?*
  AI governance is the set of frameworks, processes, and controls that ensure the AI agents and
  systems within enterprise deploys are grounded in trusted context, operate within defined
  boundaries, and can be traced and audited. It's how organizations manage the risks that surface
  when AI meets the business: unclear ownership, poor traceability, unreliable data, model bias, and
  regulatory exposure.
*What is context engineering?*
  Context engineering is the practice of structuring and delivering the right data, instructions and
  knowledge to AI systems so they can understand intent and produce accurate, relevant outputs.
  Context engineering goes beyond prompt engineering to shape everything the AI needs to act
  effectively, using both structured and unstructured data sources.
*What is Deasy Labs?*
  Deasy Labs turns just about any unstructured data, your company's enormous SharePoint, decades of
  emails, a million PDFs, into the perfect dataset for whatever your team is actually building with
  AI. For the first time, your governance policies reach all of your data. Automatic tagging and
  metadata enrichment surface what you have and what's relevant to your AI project. Filtering and
  sensitive data detection make sure the wrong content never gets in, eliminating wasted tokens. The
  result: less time wrangling data, more time shipping AI that delivers on accuracy.

Lightning cable, unlock your device, and tap “Trust” if prompted. Open Tool and wait for it to
detect your iPhone. Once detected, go to the **Tools** or **Toolbox** section and select **Virtual
Location** (or **Set Virtual Location**). Here, you can type a place name or paste latitude and
longitude coordinates to search for a specific location.

After finding the location, move or zoom the map to your exact desired spot and click **Set
Location** or **Apply**. The software will push the simulated GPS data to your device, and
location-aware apps should reflect the new position. If an app uses cached location data, you may
need to restart that app or reboot your iPhone to see the changes take effect properly. 

Before using this feature, it’s important to back up your device to prevent data loss. Only use
Virtual Location on devices you own or are authorized to control. Misusing it to bypass app
restrictions, cheat in games, or violate service policies can lead to account suspension or legal
consequences. To revert to your real location, simply reopen Virtual Location and select your true
coordinates or disconnect your device to restore standard GPS functionality.

### **3uTools Control iPhone**

3uTools allows you to manage your iPhone easily from your computer. You can control apps, files,
media, and system settings all in one platform. Its user-friendly interface makes it simple for
beginners and advanced users alike to monitor, customize, and optimize their device efficiently.

With one-click flashing and jailbreaking, 3uTools makes iOS customization safe and fast. You can
also backup and restore your data, transfer files, and manage apps directly without relying on
iTunes. Everything is streamlined for convenience and complete device control.
The software provides real-time device information like battery health, storage usage, and
performance stats. Additional features include Virtual Location, app management, and data migration,
giving you full control over your iPhone and making management easier than ever.

## The missing layer between your data & your AI

It all comes together in one platform—knowledge graphs, data observability, conversational
analytics, and contract-first governance—so AI can scale with accuracy and control.
* Jump to card card1:Context layer
* Jump to card card2:Trust layer
* Jump to card card3:Access layer

Context layer

Federated knowledge graph gives every asset a semantic identity, so AI understands business meaning,
not just column names. Bottom-up cataloging across all sources, with a Steward Agent to maintain
definitions and contract-first governance.

Trust layer

Continuous monitoring is built into the platform. It validates data health in real time, enforces
data contracts, and provides AI agents with automated trust signals, enabling them to operate
without human checkpoints.

Access layer

Natural language interface (NL-to-SQL), context-aware and embedded in workflows, lets business users
query data in Slack or Teams, delivering instant, governed answers through approved templates and
real-time validation.

## Deploy in days, not months

Transform your data catalog into an intelligence platform: the only solution that combines a
federated knowledge graph, real-time quality and observability, conversational analytics, and
contract-first governance for agentic AI. Deploy in days with 100+ connectors, friendly UI, and
immediate value for business users and data teams alike.

### Discover and understand all your data instantly

**Data & IT Leaders **can eliminate 80% of time wasted searching for data with AI-powered natural
language search, federated knowledge graphs, and hierarchical glossaries with instant business
context – built on governed metrics, relationships, and business logic defined upfront.

### Pass audits without slowing AI innovation

**Data Quality & Governance** leaders can replace rigid validation workflows with watchlists that
provide visibility without blocking contributors, embed security policies directly in data
contracts, and maintain automated audit trails with field-level lineage.

### Activate AI agents with production-ready data

**AI/ML Engineering Leaders **can eliminate the 60% AI failure rate by enabling agents to verify
data through contracts, understand context through knowledge graphs, and monitor it with real-time
observability—delivering accurate and consistent results with transparency into how answers are
produced.

**Conversational Interface **dynamic question-and-answer interactions, allowing users to ask

**Data Access Request Management** for webhooks and use-case management for data access, reducing

**Peer-to-Peer Sharing** between domain/sub-catalogs breaks down silos while maintaining governance.

**Chrome Plugin** provides comprehensive context and business definitions directly in BI dashboards.

### Build trust, mitigate risk, and ensure regulatory compliance

**Complete Data Lineage** with visualization connectors for semantic models and end-to-end tracking
of data transformations.

**Contract-First Data Products** with embedded security policies and automated violation detection
for data reliability.

**End-to-End Data Integrity** monitoring from ingestion to consumption with automated quality issue
resolution.

**Steward Agent** defines governed metrics and relationships, reducing semantic drift and ensuring
consistent analytics over time.

**AI Glossary Builder** for universal business language and automated term extraction from BI
dashboards.

**Built-in Compliance** with automated classification and audit trails for GDPR, CCPA, and BCBS 239
regulations.

### Activate trusted data with agents and automations

**Slack and Teams Integration** delivers analytics in-flow, reducing friction and expanding usage

sources.

**Real-Time Data Validation** through secure MCP server connections delivering trusted metadata to
AI tools.

**Intelligent Quality Workflows** that automatically validate inputs, flag issues, and orchestrate
quality checks across workloads.

## The missing layer between your data & your AI

It all comes together in one platform—knowledge graphs, data observability, conversational
analytics, and contract-first governance—so AI can scale with accuracy and control.
* Jump to card card1:Context layer
* Jump to card card2:Trust layer
* Jump to card card3:Access layer

Context layer

Federated knowledge graph gives every asset a semantic identity, so AI understands business meaning,
not just column names. Bottom-up cataloging across all sources, with a Steward Agent to maintain
definitions and contract-first governance.

Trust layer

Continuous monitoring is built into the platform. It validates data health in real time, enforces
data contracts, and provides AI agents with automated trust signals, enabling them to operate
without human checkpoints.

Access layer

Natural language interface (NL-to-SQL), context-aware and embedded in workflows, lets business users
query data in Slack or Teams, delivering instant, governed answers through approved templates and
real-time validation.

## Deploy in days, not months

Transform your data catalog into an intelligence platform: the only solution that combines a
federated knowledge graph, real-time quality and observability, conversational analytics, and
contract-first governance for agentic AI. Deploy in days with 100+ connectors, friendly UI, and
immediate value for business users and data teams alike.

### Discover and understand all your data instantly

**Data & IT Leaders **can eliminate 80% of time wasted searching for data with AI-powered natural
language search, federated knowledge graphs, and hierarchical glossaries with instant business
context – built on governed metrics, relationships, and business logic defined upfront.

### Pass audits without slowing AI innovation

**Data Quality & Governance** leaders can replace rigid validation workflows with watchlists that
provide visibility without blocking contributors, embed security policies directly in data
contracts, and maintain automated audit trails with field-level lineage.

### Activate AI agents with production-ready data

**AI/ML Engineering Leaders **can eliminate the 60% AI failure rate by enabling agents to verify
data through contracts, understand context through knowledge graphs, and monitor it with real-time
observability—delivering accurate and consistent results with transparency into how answers are
produced.

From data discovery to AI activation, empower every user with intelligent, governed access to your
enterprise knowledge graph.

of data transformations.

for data reliability.

**End-to-End Data Integrity** monitoring from ingestion to consumption with automated quality issue
resolution.

consistent analytics over time.

**AI Glossary Builder** for universal business language and automated term extraction from BI
dashboards.

**Built-in Compliance** with automated classification and audit trails for GDPR, CCPA, and BCBS 239
regulations.

### Activate trusted data with agents and automations

AI tools.

## We accelerate AI and Data adoption to positively impact people and organizations.

[Strategy & Transformation]

AI & Data Strategy & Transformation

We align AI implementation and user-centric adoption strategies with enterprise objectives to drive
high-value business transformations. By assessing capability maturity and designing target operating
models, we build pragmatic roadmaps that prioritize economic leverage points and establish the
governance needed for competitive advantage.

[AI Acceleration]

AI & Data for Customers

We orchestrate tailored AI ecosystems that revolutionize market engagement and unlock deep consumer
insights. By embedding precision targeting and agentic AI capabilities into every touchpoint, from
discovery to transaction and support, we build lasting loyalty and drive sustainable growth across
all emerging, hyper-personalized pathways.

[Data Foundations & BI]

AI & Data for Operations

We embed AI across your value chain, from R&D and procurement to supply chain, manufacturing &
interventions, and office operations, to unlock unprecedented operational robustness. Using
AI-powered enterprise simulations and agentic workflows, we accelerate innovation cycles and build
self-optimizing systems that maximize output.

[IT & Data Platforms]

AI & Data for Support Functions

We empower Finance, HR, and Legal teams by integrating specialized AI agents that shift focus from
transactional tasks to strategic foresight. Our solutions automate complex workflows and elevate
decision-making, while also providing the necessary tools to track and manage ESG sustainability
goals.

[Marketing Data-driven]

AI & IT Technologies

We architect the scalable infrastructure platforms and agentic engineering environments required for
the modern enterprise, from IT strategy and AI for IT to analytics and BI. Prioritizing sovereignty,
data governance & management, and AI/data tech foundations, we ensure secure, machine-readable
infrastructure primed for safely deploying complex AI systems.

## We accelerate AI and Data adoption to positively impact people and organizations.

[Strategy & Transformation]

AI & Data Strategy & Transformation

We align AI implementation and user-centric adoption strategies with enterprise objectives to drive
high-value business transformations. By assessing capability maturity and designing target operating
models, we build pragmatic roadmaps that prioritize economic leverage points and establish the
governance needed for competitive advantage.

[AI Acceleration]

AI & Data for Customers

We orchestrate tailored AI ecosystems that revolutionize market engagement and unlock deep consumer
insights. By embedding precision targeting and agentic AI capabilities into every touchpoint, from
discovery to transaction and support, we build lasting loyalty and drive sustainable growth across
all emerging, hyper-personalized pathways.

[Data Foundations & BI]

AI & Data for Operations

We embed AI across your value chain, from R&D and procurement to supply chain, manufacturing &
interventions, and office operations, to unlock unprecedented operational robustness. Using
AI-powered enterprise simulations and agentic workflows, we accelerate innovation cycles and build
self-optimizing systems that maximize output.

[IT & Data Platforms]

AI & Data for Support Functions

We empower Finance, HR, and Legal teams by integrating specialized AI agents that shift focus from
transactional tasks to strategic foresight. Our solutions automate complex workflows and elevate
decision-making, while also providing the necessary tools to track and manage ESG sustainability
goals.

[Marketing Data-driven]

AI & IT Technologies

We architect the scalable infrastructure platforms and agentic engineering environments required for
the modern enterprise, from IT strategy and AI for IT to analytics and BI. Prioritizing sovereignty,
data governance & management, and AI/data tech foundations, we ensure secure, machine-readable
infrastructure primed for safely deploying complex AI systems.

The Observation

## Enterprise AI fails not because of the model, but because of missing context

We've spent years studying how enterprises deploy AI agents. The pattern is consistent: teams build
impressive prototypes, but hit a wall when moving to production.

The wall isn't the models. It’s that no agent can reason effectively about a business it doesn't
understand — what your data means, how your teams work, how your company defines "revenue" compared
to the rest of the world.

Key Insight

When every organization has access to the same intelligence, **context becomes the differentiator**.
The enterprise that best articulates its own knowledge — its data, its processes, its meaning — will
build AI that's most useful to its people.

“We built a revenue analysis agent and it couldn't answer one question. We started to realize we
were missing this translation layer. We had no way to interpret human language against the structure
of the data.”

Joe DosSantos

VP, Enterprise Data & Analytics

## One question for AI.
## Multiple layers of context.

Through our work with enterprises, we've found that even a simple agent task requires multiple
layers of context working together. Miss one layer and the answer breaks.

Who are our top customers this quarter?

Context Layer

Answer It Needs

User Context

Who's asking — and what decision?

CS team or Sales team?

CS team optimizes for **renewal risk**

Knowledge Context

What does "customer" mean here?

Account or individual?

Parent account, **not** individual location

Meaning Context

How do you define **"top"**?

Revenue, orders, or margin?

Top = highest **net ACV**, not order count

Data Context

Which tables hold **net ACV**?

CRM vs. billing?

Use **billing.subscriptions** joined with **crm.accounts**

Data Context

How do you calculate **revenue**?

Gross or net of discounts?

Revenue net of **discounts and refunds**

80+ connectors pull context across your entire data estate — warehouse SQL, BI definitions, and
business applications — into one living graph. That graph is what everything else in the pipeline
builds on.

Atlan’s AI agents read the Enterprise Data Graph — your SQL query history, BI semantics, and

trusts.

The Observation

## Enterprise AI fails not because of the model, but because of missing context

We've spent years studying how enterprises deploy AI agents. The pattern is consistent: teams build
impressive prototypes, but hit a wall when moving to production.

The wall isn't the models. It’s that no agent can reason effectively about a business it doesn't
understand — what your data means, how your teams work, how your company defines "revenue" compared
to the rest of the world.

Key Insight

When every organization has access to the same intelligence, **context becomes the differentiator**.
The enterprise that best articulates its own knowledge — its data, its processes, its meaning — will
build AI that's most useful to its people.

“We built a revenue analysis agent and it couldn't answer one question. We started to realize we
were missing this translation layer. We had no way to interpret human language against the structure
of the data.”

Joe DosSantos

# One of the largest workforce and business solutions companies in the world, Beacon Hill enables
# people and companies to achieve beyond their aspirations.

## Substance. Scale. Synchrony.

We take a relationship‑first approach, blending the power of a $1B+ nationally-recognized,
industry-leading institution with the care of a locally-trusted boutique specialty firm. We are
fast, flexible and fully invested in the success of our clients, candidates and employees. 

[ Get To Know Us ][2]
1,500+

industry experts across the country

98%

of our top 500 customers are repeat clients

8,000

## Staffing & Recruitment Services

[Explore Our Services][3]
[Staffing & Recruitment Services - Callout]

Fill urgent needs quickly with contract or temporary staffing.

Use contract-to-hire and contingent workforce solutions to stay flexible.

Hire executive and leadership talent through direct hire and executive search.

Reduce risk by testing the candidate's culture fit before committing.

## Professional Services & Consulting Solutions

[Discover Our Solutions][4]
[Managed solutions]

Offering customized professional services and consulting solutions tailored to client needs.

An entrepreneurial approach enables agility and accountability, enabling quick innovation and
responses.

Services including strategic consulting, managed services, and outcome-driven project delivery.

Combining national reach with local expertise across sectors such as Technology, Finance, Life
Sciences and Legal.

## Client Success

### From AI Ambition to Enterprise‑Scale Reality

Beacon Hill delivered an ongoing managed AI and data engineering team model, providing end‑to‑end
consultant management, governance, and enablement fully embedded within the client’s systems,
processes and security environment.


 

[Enabling Enterprise AI at Scale with Integrated Data and ML Teams][5]

**What felt like an impossible task became a reality.**

Technology Executive, Fortune 100 Aerospace & Defense Company

## Client Success

### From Urgent to Staffed: 3,750 Requests, 93% Filled

#### by Beacon Hill Associates

In December 2021, a woman‑owned consulting firm based in California—partnering with housing and
urban development (HUD) authorities nationwide—was selected by multiple states to support their
Emergency Rental Assistance Programs (ERAP). These programs were launched under intense public
scrutiny to prevent evictions for individuals and families impacted by the COVID‑19 pandemic.

The mandate was urgent and complex: rapidly stand up large‑scale, long‑term operational teams to
support ERAP delivery across multiple jurisdictions. This required staffing hundreds of call center,
clerical, and data management professionals in a market where qualified talent was in exceptionally
high demand nationwide.

Given the scale, speed, and public‑sector accountability involved, the client needed a partner that
could reliably execute high‑volume recruitment without compromising quality, continuity, or
compliance. Building on a successful ten‑year partnership, the client turned to **Beacon Hill
Associates** to help meet this critical moment—confident in our ability to mobilize talent quickly
and perform under pressure.

> Beacon Hill rapidly staffed ERAP call centers during COVID‑19—525+ hires in 3 weeks, 60 in 48
> hours—and filled 93% of 3,750 requests across multi‑state programs.

[View the Case Study][6]

Our business can be unpredictable, and Beacon Hill always finds a solution for us and meets our
needs with little advance notice.

Vice President of Professional Services

## Client Success

### Optimizing the Contractor Hiring Process for a Leading Biopharma Manufacturer

A major biopharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, MA sought to eliminate bottlenecks and
administrative burden from its contractor hiring process. The existing system required extensive
cross‑departmental involvement—particularly from Legal—creating delays and diverting managers from
core responsibilities. OneBeacon redesigned the process end‑to‑end, centralizing administrative
tasks, streamlining supplier coordination and improving communication flow across stakeholders. The
result was a scalable, compliant, and highly efficient hiring model that reduced time‑to‑fill,
minimized risk and enabled leaders to focus on strategic initiatives rather than operational
complexities.

[Optimizing the Contractor Hiring Process for Large Pharmaceutical Manufacturer][7]

"Hiring five contractors would have been a full-time job for me and would have set me back from my
other responsibilities. Leveraging the help of [the team] made the hiring process so much smoother
and easier."

Senior Manager GT Commercial MS+T

Our recruiters connect you with opportunities nationwide, from entry-level to executive. With more
than 1,000 open positions, the right fit could be waiting for you.

# Structured Industrial Access to Latin America for Global Manufacturers

Latin America is not a market to explore. It is a region that requires structure, qualified
representation, and a defined operational pathway. ConectNext functions as a strategic bridge
enabling industrial manufacturers and solution providers to establish a credible and effective
presence across the region.

ConectNext is not a traditional directory. It is an integrated expansion platform that combines
regional visibility, governed representation, and on-the-ground execution within a unified
operational ecosystem. We work with international companies seeking to enter and scale in Latin
America, enabling structured access to relevant decision-makers, distributors, industrial buyers,
and institutional counterparts across more than 23 strategic sectors, including Industrial
Machinery, AgriTech, Pharma, Energy, Logistics, and Advanced Materials.

Latin America encompasses a market of more than 670 million people and a combined GDP exceeding USD
6.4 trillion, representing one of the world’s most dynamic growth environments. However, successful
market entry requires far more than commercial intent. It demands local presence, regulatory
clarity, cultural alignment, and trusted operational frameworks.

Through ConectNext, organizations gain structured access to the region, supported by qualified
representation, sector-specific intelligence, and a vetted operational network. This approach
ensures that expansion into Latin America is strategic, scalable, and aligned with real commercial
opportunity — not speculation.

The platform’s full structural definition is outlined in [What Is ConectNext][19].

## Why ConectNext Is the Strategic Choice for Expansion into Latin America

ConectNext is built specifically for manufacturers, industrial technology providers, and B2B
solution firms that require a structured and reliable entry into Latin America. Expanding into the
region is not simply a commercial initiative — it is an operational decision that demands market
clarity, controlled risk, and local presence. ConectNext centralizes these capabilities within a
single, integrated expansion hub.

Our platform aligns market access, regional visibility, commercial representation, and operational
execution under one coordinated framework. This enables companies to evaluate, enter, and expand in
Latin America without opening a local office, committing to high upfront investment, or navigating
fragmented networks independently.

The ConectNext model bridges global strategy with local implementation. International intent is
translated into on-the-ground execution through governed structures. Whether the objective is to
validate demand, position a brand, establish distribution pathways, or develop long-term commercial
presence, ConectNext operates as a strategic business extension in [Colombia and across Latin
America.][20]

From sector intelligence and competitive benchmarking to trade fair participation, commercial
representation, negotiation support, and structured engagement aligned with defined mandates, we
ensure that expansion initiatives remain coordinated, professional, and grounded in real commercial
opportunity.

is contextual, deliberate, and aligned with how industrial decisions are actually made.

Market presence is established through structured positioning, representation frameworks, and
defined responsibility boundaries. Engagement occurs under clear governance rules, preserving

Application modernization is a way for businesses to update their outdated systems so they can
leverage modern technologies and architecture. Having an application modernization strategy can
involve anything from migrating applications to cloud environments to adopting microservices
architectures, containerization, and code refactoring.

##### [Unlocking Efficiency: Inventory Optimization in Oil Terminal Operations][19]

Oil terminal operations rely heavily on efficient inventory management to ensure smooth product flow
within the petroleum supply chain. Fluctuating demand, storage limitations, and the sheer complexity
of handling multiple product grades pose significant challenges. To unlock efficiency, terminals
must implement strategies like advanced demand forecasting, real-time inventory monitoring, dynamic
inventory models, Just-in-Time (JIT) practices, and collaborative supply chain efforts.

# Corporate Counsel

When you work on legal issues for a company, either in-house or as outside counsel, you quickly
learn that there’s a lot of ground to cover. From employment, operations, bylaws, litigation, to
substantive issues, corporate counsel must be prepared for it all. FindLaw’s Corporate Counsel
Center is here to help, with legal articles and news on topics that will help you support your
business: Intellectual Property, Human Resources, Business Operations, Finance, Corporate
Governance, and Litigation & Disputes. Our Law Library provides a collection of articles written by
legal professionals for businesses about many different areas of substantive law. We also provide
free access to a large archive of sample contracts from public companies spanning a wide variety of
practice areas.

Connect Governance, Performance, Risk, and Compliance (GPRC) in one integrated enterprise platform.

data and relationships, and enable AI-powered decision support grounded in your business context.

The Corporater Platform

### The Foundation for Connected Enterprise Management

Manage Governance, Performance, Risk, and Compliance in one connected environment. The Corporater
Business Management Platform helps you align teams, processes, data, and decisions across the
enterprise.
* Connect Governance, Performance, Risk, and Compliance

* Automate workflows and approvals
* Improve visibility across teams and processes
* Enable AI-powered decision support

Replace disconnected tools and fragmented processes with integrated solutions designed for

in one platform to improve collaboration, accountability, and decision-making across your

## Trusted Worldwide by Data Leaders and Practitioners

Created in 1980 and internationalized in 1988, DAMA International® has helped thousands of
professionals master the principles of data management, build successful careers, and raise the
standards of our profession.
* ✓ Global Chapters in 70+ countries
* ✓ Home of the industry-standard DAMA DMBOK®
* ✓ Certifying body for the Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP®)
* ✓ Independent, volunteer-led, not-for-profit

[ Learn More About DAMA® ][126]

* ✓ Access to webinars, templates, and downloads
* ✓ Networking through local chapters and global events
* ✓ Discounts on chapter bulk book orders (10+ copies)

certification levels.

DAMA® Chapters are hubs for data professionals to learn, grow, and lead in their region. Join an
existing chapter, or start one in your country.

Local leadership with global alignment, standards, and shared momentum.

Meetups and learning sessions that keep skills current and connections strong.

birimlerinin iş ihtiyaçları doğrultusunda zamanında, doğru, kaliteli, tekil ve ilgili bir şekilde
analitik ortama veya uygulamalara sunmayı amaçlar.

danışmanlık hizmetleri sunmaktadır.

Gartner tarafından veri yönetiminde uzun yıllardır lider olarak seçilen Informatica çözümleri

Uzun yıllardır deneyimlediğimiz ve başarısını kanıtladığımız proje metodolojilerini uyguluyoruz.

Uçtan Uca Çözümler ve Danışmanlık

**DAMALINK**, bu verileri doğru ve sürdürülebilir bir altyapı ile yönetmeyi ve bu verileri iş
birimlerinin iş ihtiyaçları doğrultusunda zamanında, doğru, kaliteli, tekil ve ilgili bir şekilde
analitik ortama veya uygulamalara sunmayı amaçlar.

**DAMALINK** bu vizyon doğrultusunda şirketlere “Veri Yönetimi” konusunda uçtan uca çözümler ve
danışmanlık hizmetleri sunmaktadır.

### Pazar Lideri Platform

Gartner tarafından veri yönetiminde uzun yıllardır lider olarak seçilen Informatica çözümleri
üzerine projeler hayata geçiriyoruz.

### Kanıtlanmış Metodoloji

Uzun yıllardır deneyimlediğimiz ve başarısını kanıtladığımız proje metodolojilerini uyguluyoruz.

### Deneyim

Farklı sektörel deneyimlere sahip, veri yönetimi konusunda uzman danışman kadromuzla yanınızdayız.

CAS scientific data and CAS Newton agentic AI now integrate directly into the R&D platforms
researchers already use.
[Read the press release][77]

Conversational access to 150 years of interconnected scientific knowledge sets a new standard for
trusted discovery
[Read the press release][78]

# CAS launches CAS Intelligence Hub to transform scientific data management

Cloud-based platform delivers harmonized, AI-ready datasets at enterprise scale
[Read the press release][79]

# CAS IP Finder expands intellectual property search access across organizations

AI-enhanced intellectual property search solution simplifies complex research and expands curated
content access.
[Read the press release][80]
[Glowing blue digital fingerprint with binary code over dark tech background symbolizing
cybersecurity.]

## CAS SciFinder Discovery Platform™

Accelerate breakthroughs and get discoveries to market faster using best-in-class scientific
solutions throughout the innovation journey.

[Explore the CAS SciFinder Discovery Platform][81]CAS SciFinder Discovery Platform™

## CAS BioFinder®

Advance your drug discovery program with integrated chemistry and biological data and advanced
prediction capabilities.

[Explore CAS BioFinder][82]CAS BioFinder®

## STN IP Protection Suite™

From new users to expert searchers, accelerate your innovation journey with IP insights that save
time and money.

[Explore the STN IP Protection Suite][83]STN IP Protection Suite™

## CAS Custom Services℠

Partner with CAS to customize solutions for your unique business and R&D challenges with our
content, technology and expertise.

[Explore CAS Custom Services][84]CAS Custom Services℠

## Cultivating critical biomaterial trends from scientific literature

Focusing on cutting-edge scientific research, Westlake University sought to partner with an
organization rich in scientific knowledge expertise and state-of-the-art data analytics
capabilities.

[Right arrow]

## Curated scientific knowledge to power discovery

High-quality data is the lifeblood of today’s digital R&D pipeline. Every day, our scientists
curate, connect, and analyze the valuable data disclosed in scientific publications from around the
world to build the CAS Content Collection™, covering over 150 years of discoveries.

Our data underpins all CAS Solutions and can be licensed for machine learning or in-house workflow
integration. Our scientists also support custom data curation projects through CAS Custom Services.

researchers already use.

Conversational access to 150 years of interconnected scientific knowledge sets a new standard for
trusted discovery
[Read the press release][78]

# CAS launches CAS Intelligence Hub to transform scientific data management

Cloud-based platform delivers harmonized, AI-ready datasets at enterprise scale
[Read the press release][79]

# CAS IP Finder expands intellectual property search access across organizations

AI-enhanced intellectual property search solution simplifies complex research and expands curated
content access.
[Read the press release][80]

cybersecurity.]

Accelerate breakthroughs and get discoveries to market faster using best-in-class scientific
solutions throughout the innovation journey.

[Explore the CAS SciFinder Discovery Platform][81]CAS SciFinder Discovery Platform™

## CAS BioFinder®

Advance your drug discovery program with integrated chemistry and biological data and advanced
prediction capabilities.

[Explore CAS BioFinder][82]CAS BioFinder®

## STN IP Protection Suite™

From new users to expert searchers, accelerate your innovation journey with IP insights that save
time and money.

[Explore the STN IP Protection Suite][83]STN IP Protection Suite™

## CAS Custom Services℠

Partner with CAS to customize solutions for your unique business and R&D challenges with our
content, technology and expertise.

[Explore CAS Custom Services][84]CAS Custom Services℠

Focusing on cutting-edge scientific research, Westlake University sought to partner with an
organization rich in scientific knowledge expertise and state-of-the-art data analytics
capabilities.

High-quality data is the lifeblood of today’s digital R&D pipeline. Every day, our scientists
curate, connect, and analyze the valuable data disclosed in scientific publications from around the
world to build the CAS Content Collection™, covering over 150 years of discoveries.

Our data underpins all CAS Solutions and can be licensed for machine learning or in-house workflow
integration. Our scientists also support custom data curation projects through CAS Custom Services.

# Emerge from data chaos into data clarity

## Data management, data governance, and data monetization services for enterprises seeking to turn
## data into a strategic advantage

Put the confusion of bad data behind you and make decisions based on information you trust. With a
**100% project success rate**, our elite strategy and implementation teams will help you rapidly put
in place the technology, processes and structures you need to unlock more value from your business
data.

[ Book a Health Check ][45]

### Emerge from data chaos into data clarity

## Data management, data governance, and data monetization services for enterprises seeking to turn
## data into a strategic advantage

Put the confusion of bad data behind you and make decisions based on information you trust. With a
**100% project success rate**, our elite strategy and implementation teams will help you rapidly put
in place the technology, processes and structures you need to unlock more value from your business
data.

[ Book a Health Check ][46]

## Get to clean, consistent data that drives business value

DataCatalyst’s data management and data governance specialists bridge the gap between business and
technology – members of our team helped build some of the leading MDM and Data Governance platforms.
Our Accelerate methodology has been proven over hundreds of successful engagements to radically
improve both the quality of your data and the critical business processes that rely on it.

We are experienced systems integrators and hands-on business consultants. We don’t employ
salespeople or large teams of junior consultants, so we can focus entirely on addressing urgent
business needs and realizing value quickly.

## Data Management

Bad data costs you money every minute. Stop living with it: we’ll help you create a unified view of
your critical data domains that eliminates inefficiencies, enhances decision making, and drives
innovation. We work with leading MDM, PIM and PXM solution providers.

[Learn More][47]

## Data Governance

Your business is only as sound as your data. We’ll help you bring consistency and reliability to
your data through robust, technology-enabled processes and operational structures. Together, we’ll
build a data-driven culture where you can trust the data you see.

[Learn More][48]

## Data Monetization

Don’t get caught sleeping on the potential value of your ‘exhaust data’. We’ll help you identify,
validate, and develop entirely new revenue streams from the data your business produces as a
by-product of your primary activities.

[Learn More][49]

## Failure costs too much (so we don't allow it)

### When data management projects go off the rails, you lose more than time and money: it erodes
### trust, damages goodwill and leaves a confusing mess to clear up.

Our consultants average 15 years of experience designing and implementing data strategy and MDM
solutions. We have a 100% client success rate and we are frequently brought in to ‘Rescue and
Resuscitate’ projects that failed.

Our proprietary Accelerate methodology has evolved from these complex projects – it provides a
rapid, predictable pathway to high-quality, centralized data that supports your strategic mission.

Where others fail, we succeed. It’s our obsession.

## Gain clarity across the data lifecycle

Our lean teams of highly-skilled experts help mid to large global enterprises optimize business
value through data management and data governance. We work collaboratively on strategy and hands-on
technological implementation across the data lifecycle, specializing in the following industries:

### [ Manufacturing & Distribution ][50]

### [ Financial Services ][51]

### [ Healthcare ][52]

### [ Retail ][53]

### [ Energy ][54]

### [ Publishing ][55]

### [ Telecommunications ][56]

### [ Transportation ][57]

## Client Success Stories

## [Catalyzing discovery: How a global biotechnology leader unified data to accelerate
## innovation][58]

## Data management, data governance, and data monetization services for enterprises seeking to turn
## data into a strategic advantage

Put the confusion of bad data behind you and make decisions based on information you trust. With a
**100% project success rate**, our elite strategy and implementation teams will help you rapidly put
in place the technology, processes and structures you need to unlock more value from your business
data.

## Data management, data governance, and data monetization services for enterprises seeking to turn
## data into a strategic advantage

in place the technology, processes and structures you need to unlock more value from your business
data.

DataCatalyst’s data management and data governance specialists bridge the gap between business and
technology – members of our team helped build some of the leading MDM and Data Governance platforms.
Our Accelerate methodology has been proven over hundreds of successful engagements to radically
improve both the quality of your data and the critical business processes that rely on it.

We are experienced systems integrators and hands-on business consultants. We don’t employ
salespeople or large teams of junior consultants, so we can focus entirely on addressing urgent
business needs and realizing value quickly.

## Data Management

Bad data costs you money every minute. Stop living with it: we’ll help you create a unified view of
your critical data domains that eliminates inefficiencies, enhances decision making, and drives
innovation. We work with leading MDM, PIM and PXM solution providers.

[Learn More][47]

## Data Governance

Your business is only as sound as your data. We’ll help you bring consistency and reliability to
your data through robust, technology-enabled processes and operational structures. Together, we’ll
build a data-driven culture where you can trust the data you see.

[Learn More][48]

## Data Monetization

Don’t get caught sleeping on the potential value of your ‘exhaust data’. We’ll help you identify,
validate, and develop entirely new revenue streams from the data your business produces as a
by-product of your primary activities.

[Learn More][49]

## Failure costs too much (so we don't allow it)

### When data management projects go off the rails, you lose more than time and money: it erodes
### trust, damages goodwill and leaves a confusing mess to clear up.

Our consultants average 15 years of experience designing and implementing data strategy and MDM
solutions. We have a 100% client success rate and we are frequently brought in to ‘Rescue and
Resuscitate’ projects that failed.

Our proprietary Accelerate methodology has evolved from these complex projects – it provides a
rapid, predictable pathway to high-quality, centralized data that supports your strategic mission.

Where others fail, we succeed. It’s our obsession.

## Gain clarity across the data lifecycle

# The DGI

# Data Governance Framework

Hundreds of Data Governance programs around the world have used this logical structure as a template
for how they classify, organize, and describe the complex activities that come together to govern
data. Whether you are starting a program, joining one, or rejuvenating one, the DGI Data Governance
Framework can keep your team in sync.

[Learn more][40]
[][41]

# The DGI

# Data Governance Communications Guide

Data-centric IT projects often face challenges such as missed deadlines, budget overruns, excessive
management attention, and unmet business expectations. This is often due to ineffective
collaboration between technical and data specialty teams. While better communication seems like the
obvious solution, how do team members communicate about risks and requirements that may not be
visible to them?

The DGI Data Governance Communications Guide addresses these issues by highlighting “invisible”
data-related risks and identifying groups responsible for managing them. It also offers questions to
unveil “hidden” data-related requirements for the entire project team.

[[Data Governance Communications Guide]][42]
[Learn More][43]
[The Data Governance Institute Logo]

Membership in the world-renowned Data Governance Institute offers unlimited access to exclusive
content, discounts on training, and reduced rates for conferences and events worldwide. It’s the
perfect way to enhance your skills, stay current, and connect with industry leaders.

# The DGI

# Data Governance Communications Guide

Data-centric IT projects often face challenges such as missed deadlines, budget overruns, excessive
management attention, and unmet business expectations. This is often due to ineffective
collaboration between technical and data specialty teams. While better communication seems like the
obvious solution, how do team members communicate about risks and requirements that may not be
visible to them?

The DGI Data Governance Communications Guide addresses these issues by highlighting “invisible”
data-related risks and identifying groups responsible for managing them. It also offers questions to
unveil “hidden” data-related requirements for the entire project team.

About[Product][2][Blog][3][Docs][4][Enterprise Program][5][Get Started][6][Book a Demo][7]

Data Workers · Agentic Data Infrastructure

# Where agent
# swarms meet
# enterprise data.

Data Workers is an open-source swarm of specialized AI agents that builds pipelines, debugs
incidents, governs access, and manages schema evolution — turning days of work into minutes.

Book a Demo[Join the design partner program][8]

For Data Engineers

Stop spending 60% of your week on maintenance instead of building.

Agents monitor pipelines, diagnose failures, and cut MTTR from hours to minutes.

For Analytics Engineers

Prove your data is correct before a stakeholder reports a wrong number.

Quality scores, column-level lineage, and change-impact analysis on every model.

For Platform Leads

Replace a sprawl of disconnected tools with one MCP-native control plane.

Continuous governance, cost attribution, and cross-cloud visibility in one install.

The Industry Problem

## Your team asks the
## same data questions
## day after day.

Schema changes, pipeline failures, freshness checks, access requests, cost spikes, lineage tracing —
the questions never stop. Each one pulls an engineer out of building and into investigating. Across
a $50B+ data infrastructure market, hundreds of thousands of data engineers face this every week.

What changed in the orders schema since last deploy?
Who has access to PII columns in analytics?
Is the customer_id join safe after the migration?
What's the blast radius if I drop this column?
Find all tables with email columns
Show me all failed dbt models this week
What's causing the warehouse queue to spike?
Show me cost per query for the analytics team
What's the SLA status for tier-1 datasets?
Why did the Kafka consumer lag spike at 3 AM?
What's the p95 query latency on the analytics warehouse?
Which dbt sources have stale freshness checks?
Show me all orphaned tables with no upstream lineage
Is the new Fivetran connector syncing correctly?

# DATA IS STRATEGIC ASSET

#### Data Integration

 Whether your data is multi-cloud, hybrid, or on-premises, our hybrid data integration products
integrate all of your data and applications, in batch or real time. Integrate data and applications
in minutes and support new and complex integration patterns easily. Get high performance,
reliability, and near-universal connectivity for your mission-critical business processes.

#### Data Quality

Deliver clean, trusted data so all your projects meet your business objectives.

#### Master Data Management

#### Master Data Management

 A master data management solution is the glue that binds your systems and information together.
It’s the single source of truth for your data-driven digital transformation, providing trusted,
accurate, complete data for your customer experience program, marketing and sales operations,
omnichannel retailing, supply chain optimization, governance efforts, compliance initiatives, and
more.

#### Data Privacy Management

#### Master Data Management

As organizations embark on digital transformation, there is a clear need for enterprise data privacy
and protection. New data privacy laws and the growing enforcement of existing regulations challenge
organizations. And most organizations face rapid data growth and proliferation across the
enterprise. Organizations have more data, more use cases, and more locations than ever before.

Despite billions invested in cyber security, organizations continue to suffer misuse and loss of
customer, employee, and partner data. Data loss for organizations [grew 87 percent in
2017][11], threatening regulatory compliance and customer trust.

#### Data Governance

 Your teams need consistent, trusted data to do their work. Make sure they have it with integrated,
automated, intelligent data governance at scale.

#### Blog

  Join our blog and stay updated around Enterprise Data Management topics!

## Disrupting or getting disrupted by competitors?

#### About us

 

DGS Data Governance Systems is a company present in the Caribbean Region with the vision of
providing Enterprise Cloud Data Management services to help companies govern their data using
cut-edge technology by leveraging data as the most important asset. As result, companies can engage
in their Digital Journey, enhance the experience for their customers and stay relevant in this whole
new era!

#### Our Vision

  

**The following is part of our vision**



**Data as strategic asset**

We believe in the power of de data. Companies must govern their data and leverage the value and
insights it delivers. 

  

**Partnership with disruptors**

Technology must be used as an allied partner in order to make companies stay relevant.



**Domain experience**

Our specialists are practitioners with more than 10 years in the Enterprise Data Management
industry.

  

**Starting small, thinking big, scaling fast**

The Caribbean is the region of our birthhood, but the entire world is our target reach.

It’s always challenging to bring together the diverse datasets present in the entire business. As we
started working with Diacto, it’s pleasing to see that data becoming more visible to our business
leaders. A segment of our portfolio lacked visibility and we had very few IT resources to lean on,
Diacto team worked with our business leadership and within few weeks brought visibility to the 4-5
systems involved. The ease of doing business with Diacto and the speed and quality in which they
delivered results enabled us to see into the business in ways we never had before.

[Clayco]

It’s only been a year we started working with the Diacto team but they have truly transformed the

dashboards are now in use in every aspect of our business ranging from finance and accounting,
safety, sales and operations. Diacto team is very dedicated, knowledgeable, extremely reliable and
professional. We can count on them any time of the day and any day of the week. It’s been a true
pleasure working with them and I really hope to continue to do so in the future.

Working with Diacto with their expertise in data transformation and business analytics made a

seamless and has changed our perspective.

and capable. They took efforts to understand our business and integrate into the team projects. We
think of them as our partners and not a vendor. Management is extremely happy with the visibility
they have today, thanks to Diacto!

## AI is moving fast. Enterprise Data hasn’t caught up.

Dymium is the safety and governance layer between your AI systems and enterprise data. We enable you
to deploy GenAI, copilots, agents, and analytics with confidence—without creating data sprawl,
unmanaged copies, or irreversible exposure.

What is Dymium?

Dymium powers governed access to enterprise data in real time. Applications, analytics, and AI
agents get just enough information to work without delays or risk. No exposure. No
over-permissioning. No lag.

How It Works

Dymium evaluates every request before data is returned. Policies apply in real time based on
identity, role, and context. Access is granted only when policy conditions are met.

Architecture

Dymium enforces policy using GhostDB, GhostAPI, and GhostMCP. These enforcement points act at the
source with no staging or duplication. Data stays where it is.

Compliance-first

Dymium governs sensitive data the moment it is accessed. Every request is logged and policy-checked
in real time. Supports GDPR, HIPAA, and the AI Act. Compliance is built in with no extra work.

Solutions & Use Cases

## **Dymium enables 'just-in-time" secure data  access for applications, analytics, and agentic

* Audits every AI interaction

* Redacts private fields for compliance
* Eliminates risky data copies for BI access
* Embed multi-source data into customer-facing apps
* Role-based control with column-level redaction, obfuscation, filtering
* Seamless data connection without network complexity

Who It's For

permission for. Security

## FAQs

How Cameras Are Integrated into OEE with Fabrico?

Cameras act as an **additional visibility layer** in Fabrico’s OEE system — capturing the human and
process context that sensors or PLC data alone can’t provide. Combining **machine + human interface
+ camera data** allows Fabrico to move from partial to full visibility.

#### **1. Capturing True Equipment Availability**
* Cameras detect when a machine is stopped, even if sensors don’t register it (e.g., when a line is
  technically “on” but not producing) and people do not report.
* They help validate **microstops, idle time, and manual interventions**, closing the gap between
  logged and real downtime.
* Visual events are automatically time-stamped and linked to machine IDs, updating **Availability**
  metrics in real time.

#### **2. Improving Performance Accuracy**
* By analyzing cycle patterns visually, cameras verify whether production runs at the correct speed.
* They identify **manual slowdowns, material jams, or hesitation in operator actions** — causes
  often missed by machine data.
* This refines **Performance** calculations, ensuring every second of lost production speed is
  captured.

#### **3. Enhancing Quality Tracking**
* Cameras can spot **defects, misalignments, or rejected parts** during the production process.
* These quality losses are instantly associated with machine or batch records, improving **Quality**
  accuracy within OEE.

#### **4. Linking Human and Machine Data**
* Fabrico connects vision data with operator activity, work orders, and machine states — creating a
  **“digital twin”** of production.
* This enables teams to see not just *what* stopped the line, but *who*, *why*, and *how* it
  happened.

## FAQs

How Cameras Are Integrated into OEE with Fabrico?

Cameras act as an **additional visibility layer** in Fabrico’s OEE system — capturing the human and
process context that sensors or PLC data alone can’t provide. Combining **machine + human interface
+ camera data** allows Fabrico to move from partial to full visibility.

#### **1. Capturing True Equipment Availability**
* Cameras detect when a machine is stopped, even if sensors don’t register it (e.g., when a line is
  technically “on” but not producing) and people do not report.
* They help validate **microstops, idle time, and manual interventions**, closing the gap between
  logged and real downtime.
* Visual events are automatically time-stamped and linked to machine IDs, updating **Availability**
  metrics in real time.

#### **2. Improving Performance Accuracy**
* By analyzing cycle patterns visually, cameras verify whether production runs at the correct speed.
* They identify **manual slowdowns, material jams, or hesitation in operator actions** — causes
  often missed by machine data.
* This refines **Performance** calculations, ensuring every second of lost production speed is
  captured.

#### **3. Enhancing Quality Tracking**
* Cameras can spot **defects, misalignments, or rejected parts** during the production process.
* These quality losses are instantly associated with machine or batch records, improving **Quality**
  accuracy within OEE.

#### **4. Linking Human and Machine Data**
* Fabrico connects vision data with operator activity, work orders, and machine states — creating a
  **“digital twin”** of production.
* This enables teams to see not just *what* stopped the line, but *who*, *why*, and *how* it
  happened.

#### Write together, think together, ship together

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][25]
* [Comments & mentions][26]
* [Version history][27]
* [Templates][28]
* [GitHub integration][29]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.[
Explore features][30]
[Built for how communities actually work illustration]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][31]
* [Embeds][32]
* [Slide mode][33]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.[
See community stories][34]
[Markdown your team writes illustration]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

#### 1M+

Already powering over 1M+ API calls
Teams are using HackMD's API to feed their agents context, automate note creation, and keep
documentation in sync.
[
Read the API docs][35]

## Markdown is the layer,
## humans are still in charge

HackMD is Markdown all the way down — authored, stored, versioned, and served. Humans stay in the
loop, agents get clean content without a translation layer.
[Illustration of two document cards labeled Problem and Acceptance Criteria.]

###### Your team writes

in a real-time editor with the formatting and structure you'd expect.
[Illustration of a document card with a sparkle mark, representing agents reading Markdown content.]

###### Your agents read

the same content, the same URLs, in the format they already understand.
[Illustration of document cards with checklist items, representing review and publishing control.]

###### You stay in control

of what gets reviewed, merged, published, or rolled back. Agents don't ship to production. Your team
does.
Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Actions, OpenAI, and any tool that speaks Markdown.

### Most Recent EpisodeManaging Complexity in the Age of Mass Customization

[Listen Now][97]

As manufacturers offer more customization than ever before, managing product complexity has become a
critical challenge. Tune in with Dan Joe Barry, Vice President of Product Marketing at Configit, who
explores how companies are tackling the growing number of product configurations across engineering,
sales, manufacturing, and service. He explains how Configuration Lifecycle Management (CLM) helps
organizations maintain a single source of truth for configuration data. The result: fewer errors,
faster quoting, and the ability to deliver customized products at scale.

## Industry Today | The Digital Media Platform of Choice for Manufacturing and Industry

 

Industry Today is a trusted digital media platform that helps manufacturing, industrial, and
technology companies including software, automation, AI, and advanced engineering providers reach
decision-makers across the global industrial sector. We serve manufacturing leaders, industrial
professionals, and C-suite executives seeking insights into automation, digital transformation,
supply chain innovation, smart manufacturing, and emerging technologies.

We publish authoritative content covering industry trends, market shifts, and technology innovations
shaping the future of manufacturing. Through our integrated marketing solutions, including executive
interviews, company profiles, sponsored content (case studies, whitepapers), targeted e-newsletters,
digital advertising, and industry-focused podcasts we connect solution providers with the buyers,
partners, and influencers driving industrial growth.

critical challenge. Tune in with Dan Joe Barry, Vice President of Product Marketing at Configit, who

sales, manufacturing, and service. He explains how Configuration Lifecycle Management (CLM) helps
organizations maintain a single source of truth for configuration data. The result: fewer errors,
faster quoting, and the ability to deliver customized products at scale.
