Build connections, elevate your insights and enjoy US$200 early bird savings.

[Register & Save][170]

# AI Maturity Starts Here

Drive business growth with a structured pathway to AI capability at scale.

[Explore CMMI AIM][171]

# Time Is Running Out To Nominate!

Don’t miss your chance to nominate for the 2027 ISACA Awards. Closes 15 August.

[Nominate Now][172]

# Start Your Cybersecurity Journey Here

Spots are open for the Certified Cybersecurity Specialist beta program. Apply through 26 August.

[Apply Today][173]

## Empowering your career. Advancing trust in technology.

Wherever you are in your career, we will support your journey. For more than 55 years, ISACA has
been dedicated to equipping professionals and organizations worldwide with the expertise and
resources to lead with confidence in an ever-changing digital world. Let us help you excel with
industry-leading education, globally recognized credentials and a thriving professional community.

## Stay ahead with ISACA insights and thought leadership

Explore our latest digital trust assets, frameworks, models, white papers and resources to keep you
at the forefront of your career and build a better digital world.

[
[Security Debt: The Unseen Risk Undermining Cyber Resilience]
White Paper
Security Debt: The Unseen Risk Undermining Cyber Resilience

This paper explores where security debt comes from, how it grows, and its consequences when left
unmanaged, and shows how visibility, accountability, and shared ownership can turn debt from a
liability into a tool for building trust, agility, and long-term resilience.

][174]
[
[ISACA Journal Volume 4, 2026, The Dual Nature of Data]
ISACA Journal
Volume 4, 2026

Managing and protecting data is more complex than ever—but also more essential.

][175]
[
[AI Impact Assessment Tool]
Tool
AI Impact Assessment Tool | Digital | English

This AI Impact Assessment Tool is designed to help enterprises consider the possible ethical
consequences associated with their AI projects.

][176]
[
[LEVERAGING COBIT FOR EFFECTIVE AI SYSTEM GOVERNANCE]
White Paper
Leveraging COBIT for Effective AI System Governance

Govern AI systems more effectively with help from the COBIT framework. Learn how COBIT supports
responsible oversight as AI grows in power and complexity.

][177]

## Get the right training to enhance your career

The tech world is constantly changing. ISACA is here to help you stay one step ahead. With our
expert-led courses, hands-on training, and in-depth education, you can take your career wherever you
want to go.

[For Individuals, Advance your IT skills]
Get official exam prep

ISACA exam prep is designed to align with the current test, ensuring you are well prepared for exam
day.

[PREP FOR CREDENTIAL EXAMS][178]
[For Business, Get in-depth training]
Train your way

Find the training that is right for your career goals, your knowledge level, your learning style and
your schedule.

[SEARCH TRAINING OPTIONS][179]
[For Partners, Discover the many benefits of becoming an Accredited Training Organization]
Earn CPEs

Access essential CPE training to maintain your credentials. Members receive 70+ free annual CPE
opportunities.

[FIND CPE][180]

## Open a world of opportunities for your career

ISACA’s industry-recognized credentials validate IS/IT professionals like you across audit,
security, risk, privacy, governance and emerging tech—helping enhance your reputation and advance
your career.

Every compliance framework — HIPAA, CMMC, GDPR, PCI-DSS, IRAP — regulates data access, not who

### Kiteworks
### Solves Both.

One governance layer for employees and AI agents. No new platform, no data migration — just
compliance where the data already lives.

[Employee]
Employee

Employees share sensitive files via email, cloud folders, and managed file transfers, often across
organizational boundaries.

Kiteworks enforces one Data Policy Engine across every channel — email, SFTP, web forms, and desktop
sync — so compliance teams set a rule once and it applies everywhere.

Kiteworks consolidates all activity into a single, normalized audit log — searchable, filterable,
and SIEM-ready — so regulator evidence production is fast and automated.

Kiteworks replaces shadow IT with a secure, policy-governed platform for every file exchange —
eliminating blind spots with continuous, real-time visibility instead of waiting for the next audit.

←
→
[AI Agent]
AI Agent

AI agents authenticate as the human who set them up. Your audit trail can’t distinguish agent
actions from human actions.

Kiteworks’ MCP Server enforces RBAC and ABAC governance on every AI operation — agents receive
scoped, least-privilege access aligned with regulatory compliance requirements.

Every file an AI agent uploads or creates passes through Kiteworks’ metadata scanning, data
classification, and ABAC policy enforcement — derivative works inherit the same governance as any
human-created content.

Kiteworks is purpose-built to enforce identity, policy, encryption, and audit on every AI agent data
interaction — through its Secure MCP Server, OAuth 2.0 authentication, and comprehensive audit
logging.

←
→

Unified Governance Framework

## Four Controls. Every Accessor.
## Full Compliance.

Most organizations use fragmented tools for email security, file sharing, MFT, and now AI
governance. Kiteworks unifies all data exchange under a single compliance framework.

[Authenticated Identity]

### Authenticated Identity

Employees authenticate via SAML, MFA, and certificates. Agents authenticate with scoped delegation
tokens carrying both agent and human identity.

[Policy-Enforced Access]

### Policy-Enforced Access

ABAC Data Policy Engine evaluates every operation — considering data classification, user or agent
profile, action type, and context — before permitting access.

[Encrypted Handling]

### Encrypted Handling

TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, FIPS 140-3 validated modules. FedRAMP authorized. On-premises
and hybrid deployment for data sovereignty.

[Complete Audit Trail]

### Complete Audit Trail

Every data interaction — human or agent — is logged with identity, action, file, policy evaluated,
and outcome. Tamper-evident. SIEM-integrated. Auditor-ready.

## Every way Your Organization
## Exchanges Data, Governed.

Kiteworks unifies employee and AI agent data exchange across eight channels under a single

[Secure Email]

### Secure Email

Email Protection Gateway with DLP scanning, encryption enforcement, link expiration, and content
withdrawal.

[File Sharing and Collaboration]

### File Sharing & Collaboration

Desktop sync, secure folders, version control, and external collaboration with retention and
expiration policies.

[Managed File Transfer]

### Managed File Transfer

Enterprise MFT with Apache Airflow workflow engine, drag-and-drop authoring, scheduling, and
air-gapped configurations.

[SFTP Server]

### SFTP Server

External parties access shared folders via SFTP protocol with full authentication, encryption, and
audit logging.

[MCP Server for AI Agents]

### MCP Server for AI Agents

Model Context Protocol integration lets LLMs securely access your governed data environment with
classification-aware retrieval.

[Secure Data Forms]

### Secure Data Forms

Collect structured data in governed, branded forms with automatic secure folder storage and
submission tracking.

[REST APIs and Integrations]

### REST APIs & Integrations

Comprehensive APIs for custom applications, automation, Salesforce and iManage plugins, and SCIM
provisioning.

[Repositories Gateway]

### Repositories Gateway

Govern, protect, and streamline access to data across SharePoint, OneDrive, Box, Dropbox, and other
enterprise repositories.

Platform Overview

## Control, Protect, Track, and Report Across Every Workflow.

From authentication and policy enforcement to encryption and compliance reporting, Kiteworks
provides the complete governance stack for employee and AI agent data exchange.

[Data Policy Engine]

### Data Policy Engine (DPE)

ABAC and RBAC controls enforce authorization based on data classification, user attributes, accessor
type, and context — for both employees and agents.

[Retention and Expiration]

### Retention & Expiration

Expire files, folders, and email links after configurable time periods. Automatic retention
policies, deletion grace periods, and content withdrawal.

[Multi-Factor Authentication]

### Multi-Factor Authentication

RADIUS, PIV/CAC, SAML, email OTP, SMS OTP, certificate-based auth, and internally managed
credentials protect every human access point.

[Classification-Aware Decisions]

### Classification-Aware Decisions

Access decisions respect MIP sensitivity labels and classification tags. Agents read metadata before
downloading; ABAC enforces restrictions independently.

[Scoped Delegation Tokens]

### Scoped Delegation Tokens

AI agents receive only the access their task requires — restricted to specific folders, operations,
and time windows — not the delegating user’s full permission set.

[Admin Role Separation]

### Admin Role Separation

Separation of duties ensures administrators and compliance officers see only data appropriate to
their role and regulatory requirements.

[TLS 1.3 Encryption]

### TLS 1.3 Encryption

All data in transit is secured using TLS 1.3, the latest encryption standard, ensuring protection
against eavesdropping during file transfers and API communications.

[AES-256 Encryption]

### AES-256 Encryption

Files and metadata are encrypted at rest using AES-256, safeguarding stored data from unauthorized
access and breaches.

[FIPS 140-3 Validated]

### FIPS 140-3 Validated

Cryptographic modules are FIPS 140-3 validated, ensuring compliance with U.S. government and
regulated industry standards.

[DLP Integration]

### DLP Integration

Seamless integration with DLP providers via ICAP enables automated scanning of sensitive data and
enforcement of policy-based controls.

[Malware Scanning]

### Malware Scanning

All incoming files are scanned for malware before storage, protecting systems and users from
malicious threats.

[On-Premises Deployment]

### On-Premises Deployment

Deploy entirely on your own infrastructure for maximum data control, supporting air-gapped
environments and strict regulatory compliance.

[Immutable Audit Logs]

### Immutable Audit Logs

Every file access, transfer, and policy decision is recorded in a tamper-evident, immutable audit
trail for full accountability.

[SIEM Integration]

### SIEM Integration

Push audit events directly to your SIEM systems like Splunk, QRadar, and ArcSight for centralized
monitoring and threat detection.

[Compliance Reports]

### Compliance Reports

Generate pre-built reports for HIPAA, CMMC, GDPR, and PCI DSS using unified audit logs to simplify
regulatory compliance.

[Agent Action Tracking]

### Agent Action Tracking

Track AI agent operations with full visibility into delegation chains, task context, and policy
evaluation outcomes.

## Employees and AI Agents Face the Same Regulatory Requirements.

Every compliance framework — HIPAA, CMMC, GDPR, PCI-DSS, IRAP — regulates data access, not who
performs it. Whether it’s an employee or an AI agent, the same controls apply.

### Kiteworks
### Solves Both.

One governance layer for employees and AI agents. No new platform, no data migration — just
compliance where the data already lives.

[Employee]
Employee

Employees share sensitive files via email, cloud folders, and managed file transfers, often across
organizational boundaries.

Kiteworks enforces one Data Policy Engine across every channel — email, SFTP, web forms, and desktop
sync — so compliance teams set a rule once and it applies everywhere.

Kiteworks consolidates all activity into a single, normalized audit log — searchable, filterable,
and SIEM-ready — so regulator evidence production is fast and automated.

Kiteworks replaces shadow IT with a secure, policy-governed platform for every file exchange —
eliminating blind spots with continuous, real-time visibility instead of waiting for the next audit.

←
→
[AI Agent]
AI Agent

AI agents authenticate as the human who set them up. Your audit trail can’t distinguish agent
actions from human actions.

Kiteworks’ MCP Server enforces RBAC and ABAC governance on every AI operation — agents receive
scoped, least-privilege access aligned with regulatory compliance requirements.

Every file an AI agent uploads or creates passes through Kiteworks’ metadata scanning, data
classification, and ABAC policy enforcement — derivative works inherit the same governance as any
human-created content.

Kiteworks is purpose-built to enforce identity, policy, encryption, and audit on every AI agent data
interaction — through its Secure MCP Server, OAuth 2.0 authentication, and comprehensive audit
logging.

←
→

Unified Governance Framework

## Four Controls. Every Accessor.
## Full Compliance.

Most organizations use fragmented tools for email security, file sharing, MFT, and now AI
governance. Kiteworks unifies all data exchange under a single compliance framework.

[Authenticated Identity]

### Authenticated Identity

Employees authenticate via SAML, MFA, and certificates. Agents authenticate with scoped delegation
tokens carrying both agent and human identity.

[Policy-Enforced Access]

### Policy-Enforced Access

ABAC Data Policy Engine evaluates every operation — considering data classification, user or agent
profile, action type, and context — before permitting access.

[Encrypted Handling]

### Encrypted Handling

TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, FIPS 140-3 validated modules. FedRAMP authorized. On-premises
and hybrid deployment for data sovereignty.

[Complete Audit Trail]

### Complete Audit Trail

Every data interaction — human or agent — is logged with identity, action, file, policy evaluated,
and outcome. Tamper-evident. SIEM-integrated. Auditor-ready.

## Every way Your Organization
## Exchanges Data, Governed.

Kiteworks unifies employee and AI agent data exchange across eight channels under a single
governance, policy, and audit framework.

[Secure Email]

### Secure Email

Email Protection Gateway with DLP scanning, encryption enforcement, link expiration, and content
withdrawal.

[File Sharing and Collaboration]

### File Sharing & Collaboration

Desktop sync, secure folders, version control, and external collaboration with retention and
expiration policies.

[Managed File Transfer]

### Managed File Transfer

Enterprise MFT with Apache Airflow workflow engine, drag-and-drop authoring, scheduling, and
air-gapped configurations.

[SFTP Server]

### SFTP Server

External parties access shared folders via SFTP protocol with full authentication, encryption, and
audit logging.

[MCP Server for AI Agents]

### MCP Server for AI Agents

Model Context Protocol integration lets LLMs securely access your governed data environment with
classification-aware retrieval.

[Secure Data Forms]

### Secure Data Forms

Collect structured data in governed, branded forms with automatic secure folder storage and
submission tracking.

[REST APIs and Integrations]

### REST APIs & Integrations

Comprehensive APIs for custom applications, automation, Salesforce and iManage plugins, and SCIM
provisioning.

[Repositories Gateway]

### Repositories Gateway

Govern, protect, and streamline access to data across SharePoint, OneDrive, Box, Dropbox, and other
enterprise repositories.

Platform Overview

## Control, Protect, Track, and Report Across Every Workflow.

From authentication and policy enforcement to encryption and compliance reporting, Kiteworks
provides the complete governance stack for employee and AI agent data exchange.

Encryption & Protection
Audit & Tracking
AI Agent Governance

[Data Policy Engine]

### Data Policy Engine (DPE)

ABAC and RBAC controls enforce authorization based on data classification, user attributes, accessor
type, and context — for both employees and agents.

[Retention and Expiration]

### Retention & Expiration

Expire files, folders, and email links after configurable time periods. Automatic retention
policies, deletion grace periods, and content withdrawal.

[Multi-Factor Authentication]

### Multi-Factor Authentication

RADIUS, PIV/CAC, SAML, email OTP, SMS OTP, certificate-based auth, and internally managed
credentials protect every human access point.

[Classification-Aware Decisions]

### Classification-Aware Decisions

Access decisions respect MIP sensitivity labels and classification tags. Agents read metadata before
downloading; ABAC enforces restrictions independently.

[Scoped Delegation Tokens]

### Scoped Delegation Tokens

AI agents receive only the access their task requires — restricted to specific folders, operations,
and time windows — not the delegating user’s full permission set.

[Admin Role Separation]

### Admin Role Separation

Separation of duties ensures administrators and compliance officers see only data appropriate to
their role and regulatory requirements.

[TLS 1.3 Encryption]

### TLS 1.3 Encryption

All data in transit is secured using TLS 1.3, the latest encryption standard, ensuring protection
against eavesdropping during file transfers and API communications.

[AES-256 Encryption]

### AES-256 Encryption

Files and metadata are encrypted at rest using AES-256, safeguarding stored data from unauthorized
access and breaches.

[FIPS 140-3 Validated]

### FIPS 140-3 Validated

Cryptographic modules are FIPS 140-3 validated, ensuring compliance with U.S. government and
regulated industry standards.

[DLP Integration]

### DLP Integration

Seamless integration with DLP providers via ICAP enables automated scanning of sensitive data and
enforcement of policy-based controls.

[Malware Scanning]

### Malware Scanning

All incoming files are scanned for malware before storage, protecting systems and users from
malicious threats.

[On-Premises Deployment]

### On-Premises Deployment

Deploy entirely on your own infrastructure for maximum data control, supporting air-gapped
environments and strict regulatory compliance.

[Immutable Audit Logs]

### Immutable Audit Logs

Every file access, transfer, and policy decision is recorded in a tamper-evident, immutable audit
trail for full accountability.

[SIEM Integration]

### SIEM Integration

Push audit events directly to your SIEM systems like Splunk, QRadar, and ArcSight for centralized
monitoring and threat detection.

[Compliance Reports]

### Compliance Reports

Generate pre-built reports for HIPAA, CMMC, GDPR, and PCI DSS using unified audit logs to simplify
regulatory compliance.

[Agent Action Tracking]

### Agent Action Tracking

Track AI agent operations with full visibility into delegation chains, task context, and policy
evaluation outcomes.

### CISO Dashboard

Solutions

## Integrated Marketing. Built for Results.

Machintel combines data, media, content distribution, and campaign execution into one unified
system—so you can run better campaigns without juggling multiple vendors. Whether you need
full-service support or just the right components, we help you market smarter.

## Demand

Build Demand That Converts

[smarter%20lead%20generation.svg]

We don’t just deliver leads—we help you connect with the right buyers through smarter targeting,
cleaner data, and integrated campaign execution.

We help you -
* Improve lead quality and engagement
* Reach decision-makers in your target accounts
* Increase conversion rates across the funnel
* Reduce cost per qualified opportunity

[ Learn More ][80]

## Data

Make Every Contact Count

[Group%2028%20%281%29.svg]

The strength of your campaigns starts with the quality of your data. From enrichment and validation
to specialized intelligence and delivery infrastructure, we help ensure your outreach is precise,
compliant, and up to date.

We help you -
* Clean, complete, and enrich contact and company records
* Maintain accurate, compliant, and actionable databases
* Leverage unique insights from owned sources
* Support activation across platforms

[ Learn More ][81]

## Development

Build Smarter Digital Experiences

[Group%2029.svg]

Your digital infrastructure should support your marketing goals, not slow them down. Our development
team helps you create faster, more secure, and scalable web platforms to support campaign
performance and growth.
We help you -
* Modernize websites and web apps
* Improve performance and speed
* Ensure security and compliance
* Reduce technical debt and cost

## Three primitives in one open Semantic Context Graph

### Context

Schemas, tables, columns, dashboards, pipelines, ML models, owners, lineage, and classifications —
captured in one open metadata graph.

### Semantics

Glossary terms, metric definitions, ontologies, and W3C-standard relationships (RDF, OWL, DCAT,
Schema.org) that give your data shared business meaning.

### Memory

Corrections, decisions, approvals, feedback loops, and an auditable record of every change — across
humans and AI.

## Why OpenMetadata?

[Semantic context your AI agents and people can act on]

### Semantic context your AI agents and people can act on

OpenMetadata builds a living knowledge graph of your data for AI — what it means, how it connects,
and whether it can be trusted. Context drawn from data assets, memories, documents, and
organizational policies flows into a single Semantic Context Graph, giving both people and AI agents
the shared understanding they need to work on your data.

[API-first and schema-first, by design]

### API-first and schema-first, by design

OpenMetadata's schema-first architecture — with 700+ open specifications in JSON Schema and
RDF/JSON-LD — makes metadata programmable and extensible. Plug into your existing stack, customize
your metadata model, and build data and AI workflows that scale with your organization.

[Designed for simple setup, operations, and scalability]

### Designed for simple setup, operations, and scalability

The streamlined architecture has only four system components, making it easier to deploy, operate,
and upgrade compared to other solutions. The simple user experience is designed for technical and
non-technical users to collaborate together, while still having robust data practitioner
capabilities, all built to meet the scalability and security requirements of enterprises.

AI Readiness
AI ReadinessDiscoveryLineageObservabilityQualityCollaborationGovernance

### Give your AI agents trusted, understood data

AI agents are only as good as the data they act on. OpenMetadata's Semantic Context Graph gives
every agent the context it needs — what a dataset means, where it came from, and whether it can be
trusted — accessible with a native MCP server and AI SDK.

[Use case: AI Readiness]
MCP server for direct agent-to-context integration
AI SDK lets external agents call OpenMetadata capabilities programmatically
Context Center to centralize articles, documents, and memories for AI and humans

### Integrations

OpenMetadata's ingestion framework supports connectors for 130+ data services, with more added every
release.

## Three primitives in one open Semantic Context Graph

### Context

Schemas, tables, columns, dashboards, pipelines, ML models, owners, lineage, and classifications —
captured in one open metadata graph.

### Semantics

Glossary terms, metric definitions, ontologies, and W3C-standard relationships (RDF, OWL, DCAT,
Schema.org) that give your data shared business meaning.

### Memory

Corrections, decisions, approvals, feedback loops, and an auditable record of every change — across
humans and AI.

## Why OpenMetadata?

[Semantic context your AI agents and people can act on]

### Semantic context your AI agents and people can act on

OpenMetadata builds a living knowledge graph of your data for AI — what it means, how it connects,
and whether it can be trusted. Context drawn from data assets, memories, documents, and
organizational policies flows into a single Semantic Context Graph, giving both people and AI agents
the shared understanding they need to work on your data.

[API-first and schema-first, by design]

### API-first and schema-first, by design

OpenMetadata's schema-first architecture — with 700+ open specifications in JSON Schema and
RDF/JSON-LD — makes metadata programmable and extensible. Plug into your existing stack, customize
your metadata model, and build data and AI workflows that scale with your organization.

[Designed for simple setup, operations, and scalability]

### Designed for simple setup, operations, and scalability

The streamlined architecture has only four system components, making it easier to deploy, operate,
and upgrade compared to other solutions. The simple user experience is designed for technical and
non-technical users to collaborate together, while still having robust data practitioner
capabilities, all built to meet the scalability and security requirements of enterprises.

AI Readiness
AI ReadinessDiscoveryLineageObservabilityQualityCollaborationGovernance

### Give your AI agents trusted, understood data

AI agents are only as good as the data they act on. OpenMetadata's Semantic Context Graph gives
every agent the context it needs — what a dataset means, where it came from, and whether it can be
trusted — accessible with a native MCP server and AI SDK.

[Use case: AI Readiness]

AI SDK lets external agents call OpenMetadata capabilities programmatically
Context Center to centralize articles, documents, and memories for AI and humans

OpenMetadata's ingestion framework supports connectors for 130+ data services, with more added every

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

[ Plug in our data ][45]

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## What Exactly Is MiniTool Partition Wizard?

[All-in-one Disk Partition Manager]

### All-in-one Disk Partition Manager

As best partition manager for Windows, MiniTool Partition Wizard aims to maximize disk performance.
It helps create/resize/format partition flexibly, convert disk between MBR and GPT disks, convert
partition between NTFS and FAT32, and convert dynamic disk to basic without data loss in a few
clicks.

[Powerful BitLocker Encryption Manager]

### Powerful BitLocker Encryption Manager New Feature

Designed for users who work with encrypted drives, BitLocker Manager brings BitLocker support into
partition and disk management workflows, helping maintain both data protection and flexible disk
management.

[Smart Duplicate Files Cleaner]

### Smart Duplicate Files Cleaner

Duplicate Cleaner can quickly locate and remove duplicate files on your PC and external drives,
instantly freeing up storage space. It helps you effortlessly identify unnecessary copies hiding in
every folder, clean up clutter, and make room for new data.

[Effective Data Recovery Program]

### Effective Data Recovery Program

MiniTool partition manager software offers two perfect solutions for data recovery. Partition
Recovery Wizard can find and recover the lost partitions while Data Recovery feature can recognize
and recover lost/deleted files from damaged, formatted, inaccessible FAT/NTFS/exFAT drives and
Desktop/Recycle Bin/specified folders.

([Which edition should you get for Data Recovery?][34])

[Powerful Disk Clone Tool]

### Powerful Disk Clone Tool

Disk clone or system migration is most frequently used to back up and upgrade hard drive. Disk
cloning works perfectly when you are forced to make an instant backup. System migration returns you
to act on the new disk in a while. No need to spend hours reinstalling operating system and
applications.

[Striking Disk Diagnostic Master]

### Striking Disk Diagnostic Master

As comprehensive disk check master, MiniTool Partition Wizard can measure disk read/write speed,
analyze disk usage on computer, verify the file system integrity of a volume and fix logical file
system errors, and quickly detect if there are bad sectors on the drive.

[Get Partition Wizard][35]

## Who Is Using MiniTool Partition Wizard?

Home and Home Office

Today most home and home office users choose MiniTool Partition Wizard to redistribute hard drives
and convert disk partition within simple steps.

Server Users

Server users always rate MiniTool Partition Wizard as their first choice for it bolsters data
security protection and boosts server performance.

Enterprise Users

For enterprises and technicians, more editions are provided so that they are able to deploy MiniTool
Partition Wizard on multiple computers.

## Why MiniTool Partition Wizard?

Trusted by Millions of Editors and Clients

MiniTool’s Partition Wizard is an ideal tool that’ll help you manage the files on your PC more

quality and governance integrated seamlessly with SAP solutions.

OUR SERVICES

## How we operate across your second supply chain.

Customers come in at the depth that fits their moment. A discrete project—agentic commerce
readiness, an integration assessment, a stalled migration, a PIM that’s outgrown itself—is a
perfectly good place to start, and plenty of engagements stop there. Others bring us in to build and
run a specific platform or process on their behalf. The customers who get the most out of the
relationship trust us with the whole thing as a continuous discipline. Most of those didn’t start
that way.

### Data Strategy, Enhancement, and Governance

Trustworthy product, customer, and operational data feeding every system that depends on it. We
design the data model your business actually needs, enrich what’s already there, and govern it as
the catalog grows.

[ See our data services ][110]

### Commerce Platforms

Replatforming is the highest-risk moment a commerce operation will face. Handled right, it’s also a
huge revenue opportunity; coming off a platform that was capping growth and onto one that fits the
operation underneath it. We run the cutover and own the results.

[ See our commerce platform services ][111]

### PIM and MDM

Our services include implementation, migration, and ongoing operation. Platform choice matters; data
model and governance matter more. Most PIM projects stall in the model. We build it so they don’t.

[ See our PIM/MDM services ][112]

### Integration Services

The connections between your systems are where the risk lives and where our capabilities thrive. We
build integrations faster and at a lower cost with our engineer-lead, AI-powered pipeline, and we
stay accountable for their performance after go-live.

[ See our integration services ][113]

### Product Catalog Ops

You’re paying for catalog work twice: once in salaries, once in the sales it was supposed to
produce. Ascend Catalog Pro is a managed team that runs your catalog operations and ties every hour
to outcomes you can take to the board.

[ See managed product catalog services ][114]
HOW IT WORKS

## Digital commerce as a discipline.

The digital supply chain isn’t a single system you can staff for. It’s data, platforms,
integrations, catalog operations, and intelligence—five specializations that have to work together
flawlessly every day, across every transaction. We build, connect, and run the whole thing as one
discipline. That’s the difference between a stack that works on day one and an operation that’s
still working on day five hundred.

##### Data Quality

The critical foundation: SKU enrichment, catalog cleanup, taxonomy that holds.

##### Platforms

The commerce engines that take the order and keep taking it.

##### Intelligence

AI-powered observability and proactive monitoring across the whole stack.

##### Integrations

Smart, monitored connections that hold under load and don’t drift.

##### Catalog Management

Product data architecture built to survive contact with external sellers.

[ Talk to us about your digital supply chain ][115]
CASE STUDY

## People, Process and Partnership: Digital Transformation Success Story

Psycho Bunny, a leading high-quality men's clothing company, has tripled its business in the past
two years and is committed to delivering the best products and services to its customers.

[ Read the case study ][116]
30%

revenue increase

93%

fewer short shipments

90%

inventory accuracy from end-to-end visibility

INDUSTRIES

## When complex data moves, our customers’ products follow.

We work in industries where the digital supply chain is the supply chain—where wrong fitment data
ships the wrong part, where one stale catalog cascades to twelve channels, where a 2% integration
failure rate means hundreds of failed transactions a week. Industries where the cost of “good
enough” is measured in revenue, returns, and trust.

Industries we serve:

[
Automotive ][117]
[
Wholesale Distribution ][118]
[
Manufacturing ][119]
[
Retail ][120]
[
CPG ][121]
[ View all industries ][122]

## Why Pivotree?

30 +
Years in the business
350 +
Experts globally
$ 9 B+
Online GMV
200 +
Customers worldwide

## The Pivotree advantage.

### One team, before and after

The people who design your architecture are the people who run it. When an incident hits at 2 AM,
the engineer on call has been in your system for months, not minutes.

### Operator fluency over platform fluency

We’ve installed, built on, and operated every major platform in the commerce stack. The advantage
isn’t the certifications—it’s that we’ve seen these systems before, and our AI tooling watches them
for what our architects already know to spot.

### Go-live is where the work starts

Some partners celebrate go-live and move on. Meanwhile, post-launch issues arise, and your business
keeps evolving. That’s the work we stay for, with AI tooling on the system and architects in the
decision loop.

### 200+ customers’ worth of expertise

The integration that’s slowly drifting, the catalog buckling under SKU growth, the middleware
nobody’s touched in three years—we’ve seen the shapes before, and it’s hard to surprise us.

### Every layer under one roof

Data, platforms, integrations, and operations in one team. Whatever crosses the layers (and most
things do) gets handled by the people in the same room.

### Real intelligence, boosted

Our architects bring decades of deep operator experience. AI tooling handles the predictable work at
speed, so they spend their time on judgment calls. You can’t prompt your way to that kind of
expertise.

[ Learn more about us ][123]
DATA VS. COMMERCE

## Get more commerce insights with our podcast.

Everyone wants to achieve frictionless commerce, but what does that look like in practice? Every
week, we dig deep into the tension between data and commerce and find new ways to strengthen the
most expensive relationship in your business

[ Listen on Apple Podcasts ][124] [ Listen on Spotify ][125]

## Talk to us about your second supply chain.

Most conversations start with a replatform on the calendar, a catalog that’s outgrown its PIM, or an
SI that’s just walked out the door. Tell us where you are, and we’ll tell you how we can help.

OUR PARTNERS

## We don’t work alone.

Modern commerce is too complex for any single vendor to do solo. We work with the platforms,
integrators, and infrastructure providers that own pieces of the digital supply chain, and we make
sure those pieces actually connect.

integrations, catalog operations, and intelligence—five specializations that have to work together
flawlessly every day, across every transaction. We build, connect, and run the whole thing as one
discipline. That’s the difference between a stack that works on day one and an operation that’s
still working on day five hundred.

##### Data Quality

The critical foundation: SKU enrichment, catalog cleanup, taxonomy that holds.

##### Platforms

The commerce engines that take the order and keep taking it.

##### Intelligence

AI-powered observability and proactive monitoring across the whole stack.

##### Integrations

Smart, monitored connections that hold under load and don’t drift.

##### Catalog Management

Product data architecture built to survive contact with external sellers.

[ Talk to us about your digital supply chain ][115]
CASE STUDY

## People, Process and Partnership: Digital Transformation Success Story

Psycho Bunny, a leading high-quality men's clothing company, has tripled its business in the past
two years and is committed to delivering the best products and services to its customers.

[ Read the case study ][116]
30%

revenue increase

93%

fewer short shipments

90%

inventory accuracy from end-to-end visibility

INDUSTRIES

## When complex data moves, our customers’ products follow.

We work in industries where the digital supply chain is the supply chain—where wrong fitment data
ships the wrong part, where one stale catalog cascades to twelve channels, where a 2% integration
failure rate means hundreds of failed transactions a week. Industries where the cost of “good
enough” is measured in revenue, returns, and trust.

Industries we serve:

[
Automotive ][117]
[
Wholesale Distribution ][118]
[
Manufacturing ][119]
[
Retail ][120]
[
CPG ][121]
[ View all industries ][122]

## Why Pivotree?

30 +
Years in the business
350 +
Experts globally
$ 9 B+
Online GMV
200 +
Customers worldwide

## The Pivotree advantage.

### One team, before and after

The people who design your architecture are the people who run it. When an incident hits at 2 AM,
the engineer on call has been in your system for months, not minutes.

### Operator fluency over platform fluency

We’ve installed, built on, and operated every major platform in the commerce stack. The advantage
isn’t the certifications—it’s that we’ve seen these systems before, and our AI tooling watches them
for what our architects already know to spot.

### Go-live is where the work starts

Some partners celebrate go-live and move on. Meanwhile, post-launch issues arise, and your business
keeps evolving. That’s the work we stay for, with AI tooling on the system and architects in the
decision loop.

### 200+ customers’ worth of expertise

The integration that’s slowly drifting, the catalog buckling under SKU growth, the middleware
nobody’s touched in three years—we’ve seen the shapes before, and it’s hard to surprise us.

### Every layer under one roof

Data, platforms, integrations, and operations in one team. Whatever crosses the layers (and most
things do) gets handled by the people in the same room.

### Real intelligence, boosted

Our architects bring decades of deep operator experience. AI tooling handles the predictable work at
speed, so they spend their time on judgment calls. You can’t prompt your way to that kind of
expertise.

[ Learn more about us ][123]
DATA VS. COMMERCE

## Get more commerce insights with our podcast.

Everyone wants to achieve frictionless commerce, but what does that look like in practice? Every
week, we dig deep into the tension between data and commerce and find new ways to strengthen the
most expensive relationship in your business

[ Listen on Apple Podcasts ][124] [ Listen on Spotify ][125]

## Talk to us about your second supply chain.

Most conversations start with a replatform on the calendar, a catalog that’s outgrown its PIM, or an
SI that’s just walked out the door. Tell us where you are, and we’ll tell you how we can help.

OUR PARTNERS

## We don’t work alone.

Modern commerce is too complex for any single vendor to do solo. We work with the platforms,
integrators, and infrastructure providers that own pieces of the digital supply chain, and we make
sure those pieces actually connect.

## **What Makes Data ****Agentic-Ready****?**

AI agents are only as trustworthy as the data they act on. Most enterprise data isn’t ready.
Agentic-Ready Data is visible, reliable, accountable, and complete.  That’s the higher standard AI
needs to operate with confidence.

[1 icon]

### UNIFIEDMake your data visible

Enterprise data exists across every signal and every system, but not always in a way AI can see or
understand. Make it available, connected, and easy to navigate so AI can discover and use it
wherever decisions are made.

[2 icon]

### HIGH QUALITYMake your data reliable

Agents move fast, and AI doesn’t pause to validate bad inputs. Keep your data accurate, complete,
consistent, and continuously monitored so every AI decision starts with trusted information.

[3 icon]

### GOVERNEDMake your data accountable

As AI starts acting on your behalf, transparency and control become non-negotiable. Make every AI
decision based on data that is traceable, explainable, and governed by business policies, so AI
operates responsibly.

[4 icon]

### ENRICHEDMake your data complete

Your internal data alone isn’t enough for agentic AI. Adding rich location, business, and consumer
context gives AI the complete picture it needs to understand, reason, and act with confidence.

[Link icon]

Data must meet all these conditions continuously, wherever decisions are made. The Precisely Data
Integrity Suite makes your data AI-ready in one unified system, so agents can drive business
outcomes at enterprise scale.

## **What Makes Data ****Agentic-Ready****?**

AI agents are only as trustworthy as the data they act on. Most enterprise data isn’t ready.
Agentic-Ready Data is visible, reliable, accountable, and complete.  That’s the higher standard AI
needs to operate with confidence.

[1 icon]

### UNIFIEDMake your data visible

Enterprise data exists across every signal and every system, but not always in a way AI can see or
understand. Make it available, connected, and easy to navigate so AI can discover and use it
wherever decisions are made.

[2 icon]

### HIGH QUALITYMake your data reliable

Agents move fast, and AI doesn’t pause to validate bad inputs. Keep your data accurate, complete,
consistent, and continuously monitored so every AI decision starts with trusted information.

[3 icon]

### GOVERNEDMake your data accountable

As AI starts acting on your behalf, transparency and control become non-negotiable. Make every AI
decision based on data that is traceable, explainable, and governed by business policies, so AI
operates responsibly.

[4 icon]

### ENRICHEDMake your data complete

Your internal data alone isn’t enough for agentic AI. Adding rich location, business, and consumer
context gives AI the complete picture it needs to understand, reason, and act with confidence.

[Link icon]

Data must meet all these conditions continuously, wherever decisions are made. The Precisely Data
Integrity Suite makes your data AI-ready in one unified system, so agents can drive business
outcomes at enterprise scale.

[Explore the Data Integrity Suite][106]

# A better internet starts with privacy and freedom

Take control of your data with end-to-end encryption.

[Create a free account][143][Compare plans][144]
Trusted by over 100 million users and organizations
Average app rating[4.5 stars]
[CNET, Independent IndyBest and PCMag Editors' Choice]
Recommended by the experts

## Communicate and browse. Privately.

[Proton Mail]
[Proton Calendar]

### Proton Mail and Calendar

Defeat spam, tracking, and ads with encrypted [email][145] and a secure calendar.

[Get it for free][146][Explore Proton Mail
][147]
[Proton VPN]

### Proton VPN

Browse privately and access content from anywhere with a secure, fast [VPN(new window)][148].

[Get Proton VPN][149][Explore Proton VPN
][150]
Mail

#### No trackers. No distractions. Just your email.

## Store, share, collaborate. Securely.

### Proton Drive

Safeguard your files and photos with end-to-end encrypted [cloud storage][151].

][153]

### Proton Docs

Edit as a team with [collaborative documents][154], safe from prying eyes.

### Proton Sheets

Protect and organize sensitive data in encrypted [online spreadsheets][157].

][159]

## Defend your digital life from hackers. Effortlessly.

[Proton Pass]

### Proton Pass

Generate and store strong passwords with a [password manager][160] that automatically syncs across
all your devices and alerts you to breaches.

[Get it for free][161][Explore Proton Pass
][162]
[Proton Authenticator]

### Proton Authenticator

Sync and back up your two-factor authentication (2FA) codes across all devices with a secure
[authenticator app][163].

[Get it for free][164][Explore Proton Authenticator
][165]

## Host and join confidential meetings

[Proton Meet]

### Proton Meet

Collaborate with your team or catch up with family and friends knowing your [video calls][166] are
protected by end-to-end encryption.

[Start a meeting][167][Explore Proton Meet
][168]

## Powerful AI that respects your privacy.

[Lumo AI]

### Lumo by Proton

An [AI assistant][169] where every conversation is actually confidential.

[Start a chat][170][Explore Lumo
][171]

## Protect your business with easy-to-use encrypted solutions.

[Proton]

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

## Choose an internet where your privacy comes first

One account for all Proton services.

[Create a free account][187]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

# AI-Enhanced Software Development & White-Label Platforms

## We design, build, and scale secure digital products for fintechs, startups, and enterprises
## worldwide. By combining 25+ years of engineering with AI-assisted delivery, we ship MVPs and
## production systems faster without compromising quality.

[DISCUSS YOUR PROJECT][44]

## From MVP to Production-Grade Software

### approach

We start with a rapid, AI-accelerated MVP to validate your idea and deliver results **in weeks** —
not months. Then we evolve that MVP into a stable, secure, and scalable production-grade system
designed for long-term success.

Stage 1: MVP Development (4 weeks)
* Business requirements gathered in 1 week
* AI + analysts create models and SRS in 1 week
* Code and integrations delivered in 2 weeks

**Result**: A functional MVP in 4 weeks at a clear cost

Stage 2: Scaling to Production-Grade
* Architecture-first design for stability and growth
* System decomposition for safe, targeted changes
* AI applies architectural patterns while experts validate
* Continuous improvement and enterprise-level integrations

**Result**: A production-grade solution ready for scale, compliance, and real-world use

This two-stage approach gives you **speed** when you need it, and **reliability** when it matters
most.

## Who We Build Software For

### clients

Every organization has unique needs. Our delivery model adapts to your stage, constraints, and
industry requirements.

#### Established Enterprises & Business Units

Modernize legacy systems, ensure compliance, and streamline operations with production-grade
platforms.

#### Startups & High-Growth Teams

Launch quickly with an MVP, then scale into robust software as your user base grows.

#### Product Companies & B2B Platforms

Extend your product with new modules, APIs, and integrations while maintaining performance and
reliability.

#### Regulated Industries (Finance, Healthcare, Insurance)

Build secure, compliant platforms designed for trust and resilience.

#### Marketplaces & Platforms

Develop scalable, many-to-many platforms with governance, secure transactions, and intuitive UX.

#### Real-Time & High-Load Systems

AI is ready to act. But can your business bet on the outcomes? Fragmented or ungoverned data puts AI
decisions at risk. Unify and govern enterprise master data to power trustworthy intelligence — so AI
agents and teams can act with confidence at scale.

[ Explore the platform ][102] [ See AI in action ][103]

ANNUAL REPORT

## Our Year in Review

We’ve delivered the strongest financial performance in our history, driven by continued execution of
our strategy and the increasing impact of investments made in recent years – while further
strengthening our position in a fast-evolving market. See how Stibo Systems is leading the way.

[ Explore the report ][104]
[Annual Report Visuals]

## Why enterprise AI breaks — and how to fix it

The gap between AI expectations and AI outcomes is usually a data problem. When the data AI relies
on is fragmented, inconsistent or ungoverned, trust breaks down fast. The fix is an authoritative
foundation — which is what master data management (MDM) is becoming for the AI era. It applies
across the data that drives business — product, customer, supplier and partner — so decisions stay
consistent and defensible wherever they happen. It’s your trusted intelligence platform: the bedrock
of AI decisions you can believe in.

[caution icon]
Challenge
Wrong answers
AI can confidently return responses that are flat-out wrong when it’s pulling from incomplete,
outdated or conflicting enterprise data.
[checkmark icon]
Solution
Unify enterprise truth
Connect critical business data across systems so AI and teams operate from the same authoritative
foundation.
[caution icon]
Challenge
Inconsistent outcomes
Different systems, records and definitions lead different models, agents and teams to different
conclusions.
[checkmark icon]
Solution
Activate trusted intelligence
Deliver the same trusted data and meaning wherever decisions happen, so outcomes stay consistent
across the business.
[caution icon]
Challenge
Unexplainable decisions
Without lineage, relationships and business context, it’s hard to understand — much less defend —
why AI made a decision.
[checkmark icon]

Add shared meaning

just raw fields.

# About the World Air Quality Index project

## How to use this web application

To get more information about a specific city, move your move over any of the the flags in the above
map, then click to get the full air pollution historical data.


────────┬─────────────────────────────┬─────────────
Good    │Unhealthy                    │Very         
        │for sensitive groups         │Unhealthy    
────────┼─────────────────────────────┼─────────────
Moderate│Unhealthy                    │Hazardous    
────────┴─────────────────────────────┴─────────────


## Air Quality Index (AQI) Calculation

The Air Quality Index is based on measurement of particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10), Ozone (O3),
Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2), Sulfur Dioxide (SO2) and Carbon Monoxide (CO) emissions. Most of the
stations on the map are monitoring both PM2.5 and PM10 data, but there are few exceptions where only
PM10 is available.

All measurements are based on hourly readings: For instance, an AQI reported at 8AM means that the
measurement was done from 7AM to 8AM.

surfaces where your existing customers could be buying more from you.

#### Featured publications:

[
][4]
[Jobs and the Future of Work][5]

[Artificial Intelligence and the Future of Entry-Level Work: A Framework for Safeguarding and
Reinventing Early Career Pathways][6]

Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping how organizations hire, develop and advance talent, and
this is most visible at entry-level. Globally, more than one in three young workers are employed in
occupations with medium to high exposure to AI-driven task change. How these roles evolve will have
significant implications for organizational performance, workforce participation and economic
mobility.

both how energy systems perform today and whether the conditions for future progress are in place.
Jun 18, 2026[Download PDF][11]
[
][12]
[Economic Growth][13]

[Closing the Gender Gap in Senior Leadership][14]

This insight report presents a global, cross-industry analysis of where progress towards gender
parity in senior leadership stands today and the structural factors that continue to shape it.
Developed by the World Economic Forum’s Centre for the New Economy and Society as part of the Global
Gender Parity Sprint, the report draws on novel data from the LinkedIn Economic Graph Research
Institute and Egon Zehnder, alongside case studies and insights from leaders across business,
government, academia and civil society.
Jun 18, 2026[Download PDF][15]
[
][16]
[Nature and Biodiversity][17]

[The Regenerative Blue Economy: Pathways to Prosperity][18]

Marine ecosystems continue to degrade under pressure from warming seas, rising tides, pollution and
overuse, undermining the long-term well-being of the communities and economies that depend on them.
This report examines how to shift from the status quo – which perpetuates this decline – towards a
regenerative blue economy.
Roughly 40% of the world's population lives within 100 km of the coast. That narrow band – just 5%
of inhabited land – generates 30-50% of global GDP and concentrates ports, energy infrastructure,
aquaculture, desalination and tourism. This is where most of the regenerative blue economy will be
built. The report analyses how the interaction of four systemic levers – integrated ocean
governance, innovative and equitable finance, investment in human capacity, and advances in
technology and AI – can help transform these ocean-based industries.
Rather than focusing on short-term returns, a regenerative approach offers an ambitious vision of
blue economic activity that helps restore ecosystems, strengthen resilience and support equitable
prosperity for coastal communities within planetary limits. This approach challenges decision-makers
to judge success not only by the wealth generated from the ocean, but by the extent to which that
wealth supports restoration, fairness and intergenerational well-being.
Jun 8, 2026[Download PDF][19]
[
][20]
[Nature and Biodiversity][21]

[Plastic Pollution and Biodiversity: a Global Overview][22]

Every year, an estimated 130 million tonnes of plastic waste are unmanaged or improperly discarded,
polluting soils, waterways and seas. While efforts continue to promote a circular economy and pursue
a global plastics treaty, far less attention has focused on how plastic pollution affects
biodiversity and the ecosystem services that underpin economies and human well-being. This report
addresses that gap.

Plastic pollution has particularly severe impacts on sectors such as fisheries, agriculture and
tourism, which directly depend on healthy natural systems. These impacts demonstrate that
biodiversity loss and plastic pollution are not just environmental challenges, but economic and
resilience challenges too. More than half of global GDP is moderately or highly dependent on nature.
So degraded ecosystems create growing risks for communities, industries and economies at a time when
they are already under pressure from climate change and geopolitical uncertainty.

This report draws on field assessments conducted across nine geographies on three continents –
developed by the World Economic Forum’s Global Plastic Action Partnership (GPAP) – which together
represent one of the most detailed multi-country evidence bases on plastic pollution and
biodiversity to date. It concludes with recommendations for governments, corporates, investors and
communities to translate this evidence into coordinated action to deliver measurable benefits for
nature, people and economies.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping how organizations hire, develop and advance talent, and
this is most visible at entry-level. Globally, more than one in three young workers are employed in
occupations with medium to high exposure to AI-driven task change. How these roles evolve will have
significant implications for organizational performance, workforce participation and economic
mobility.

[Economic Growth][13]

[Closing the Gender Gap in Senior Leadership][14]

This insight report presents a global, cross-industry analysis of where progress towards gender
parity in senior leadership stands today and the structural factors that continue to shape it.
Developed by the World Economic Forum’s Centre for the New Economy and Society as part of the Global
Gender Parity Sprint, the report draws on novel data from the LinkedIn Economic Graph Research
Institute and Egon Zehnder, alongside case studies and insights from leaders across business,
government, academia and civil society.
Jun 18, 2026[Download PDF][15]
[
][16]
[Nature and Biodiversity][17]

[The Regenerative Blue Economy: Pathways to Prosperity][18]

Marine ecosystems continue to degrade under pressure from warming seas, rising tides, pollution and
overuse, undermining the long-term well-being of the communities and economies that depend on them.
This report examines how to shift from the status quo – which perpetuates this decline – towards a
regenerative blue economy.
Roughly 40% of the world's population lives within 100 km of the coast. That narrow band – just 5%
of inhabited land – generates 30-50% of global GDP and concentrates ports, energy infrastructure,
aquaculture, desalination and tourism. This is where most of the regenerative blue economy will be
built. The report analyses how the interaction of four systemic levers – integrated ocean
governance, innovative and equitable finance, investment in human capacity, and advances in
technology and AI – can help transform these ocean-based industries.
Rather than focusing on short-term returns, a regenerative approach offers an ambitious vision of
blue economic activity that helps restore ecosystems, strengthen resilience and support equitable
prosperity for coastal communities within planetary limits. This approach challenges decision-makers
to judge success not only by the wealth generated from the ocean, but by the extent to which that
wealth supports restoration, fairness and intergenerational well-being.
Jun 8, 2026[Download PDF][19]
[
][20]
[Nature and Biodiversity][21]

[Plastic Pollution and Biodiversity: a Global Overview][22]

Every year, an estimated 130 million tonnes of plastic waste are unmanaged or improperly discarded,
polluting soils, waterways and seas. While efforts continue to promote a circular economy and pursue
a global plastics treaty, far less attention has focused on how plastic pollution affects
biodiversity and the ecosystem services that underpin economies and human well-being. This report
addresses that gap.

Plastic pollution has particularly severe impacts on sectors such as fisheries, agriculture and
tourism, which directly depend on healthy natural systems. These impacts demonstrate that
biodiversity loss and plastic pollution are not just environmental challenges, but economic and
resilience challenges too. More than half of global GDP is moderately or highly dependent on nature.
So degraded ecosystems create growing risks for communities, industries and economies at a time when
they are already under pressure from climate change and geopolitical uncertainty.

This report draws on field assessments conducted across nine geographies on three continents –
developed by the World Economic Forum’s Global Plastic Action Partnership (GPAP) – which together
represent one of the most detailed multi-country evidence bases on plastic pollution and
biodiversity to date. It concludes with recommendations for governments, corporates, investors and
communities to translate this evidence into coordinated action to deliver measurable benefits for
nature, people and economies.

[Deepening Divides: The Cost of a More Fragmented Financial System][26]

2025 and early 2026 marked a turning point for the global trade and financial systems as states
deployed economic statecraft on a scale not seen in the modern era, accelerating and deepening
fragmentation. These global trends present concrete risks and opportunities to emerging markets and
developing economies, which are explored in detail in a case study of major African economies. The
report offers new quantitative analysis and renews the private sector’s call to preserve the core
elements of the global financial system that enable economic growth and long-term prosperity.
